title: Head of Technology
description:
We are hiring a Head of Technology for the garden3d creative collective, to lead engineering at Sanctuary Computer and garden3d in the era of agentic computer code.

Original job posting link 

About garden3d 

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

Weâre the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer - Development 

At Sanctuary Computer weâre building a different type of technology shop â one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX - Design 

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and weâve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

Weâre building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Index - Community 

Index is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK â Media 

At garden3d, weâre in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations

Lightphone 
Mill 
IngredientAI 

â°ï¸ The Head of Technology Role

The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.

This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.

They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the engineers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

Responsibilities & Mandates 

ï¸ Systems that hold up 

We build web apps, native apps, data pipelines, content platforms and connected devices for clients who can't afford for them to fall over. This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.

All in on agentic development 

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering 

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer 

Sanctuary Computer is where our engineering standard lives, so this is where most of their energy goes. They set what good code review looks like, keep our senior developers sharp on architecture and quality, and make sure that bar holds without slowing the team down.

Hiring and empowering the very best 

They are a magnet for exceptional engineers. They know where to find them, how to convince them, and how to give them enough room to do their best work while still holding them to the standard. People who work for this person should get visibly better, and should say so.

Estimation, scoping and delivery 

They make sure our teams can reliably estimate and story point the work ahead, and that we deliver at a pace that meets the dates we promised and protects our margins. When an estimate is wrong, they find out why and fix the process.

The technical voice in new business 

Our clients include Google, Stripe, Figma, Mozilla and The Nobel Prize. This person joins new business calls as the trusted technical consultant, scopes the work, writes the technical side of proposals, and can explain a hard tradeoff to a client's CTO and their CEO in the same meeting.

Hardware sense 

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story 

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture 

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

Â Special Projects 

In addition to day to day responsibilities, hereâs an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years â

- Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer builds, with loops and evals the whole team trusts
- Setting the shared technical conventions every garden3d studio builds from
- Landing the kind of flagship engineering engagement that changes what people think we do
- Hiring the next generation of the engineering team, across every garden3d studio
- Turning the internal tools and agents we build for ourselves into products
- Partnering with the Head of Design so our own studio websites are as well engineered as they are designed
Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have: 

- 12+ years building software, at least three of them leading engineers inside a studio, agency, startup or founder-led company
- Deep experience engineering complex systems, shipped and run in production: distributed services, data pipelines, multi-platform products
- A true technology generalist, comfortable across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure and native
- A strong preference for practical engineering: convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms as a service over bespoke infrastructure
- All in on agentic development: loop engineering, evals, and agents doing real work in a real codebase
- Fluency across most of our stack: React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir & Phoenix, Sanity, Postgres, Redis. You won't use all of it every week, but you should be able to review any of it
- Experience as the technical lead in winning work: scoping, estimating and pitching to clients
- A track record of hiring exceptional engineers, and of people who got measurably better working for them
- Hands-on. This person can still write the code, not only review it (and will get on the tools when the need arises)
Nice-to-have: 

- A sense of how hardware works: firmware, embedded systems, IoT, and shipping software for physical products
- Experience in a client services environment (a consultancy, agency or studio)
- Experience in a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect role
- Open source projects they've started or maintained
- Experience fostering close collaboration between design and engineering teams
- Experience inside a worker-owned, open-book, or otherwise unusual company
- A network in the engineering community: the meetups, the conferences, the people worth hiring
- Interests in design, art, music, food or fashion. We find these people have a well rounded sense of quality
Who you are

The person weâre looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. Theyâre flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work âsmartâ by carefully managing their workflow and team.

How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, weâll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where weâre going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

Compensation

This is a permanent leadership role. If this individual exceeds expectations in their first four months, we'll shape the permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as the studios and their revenue do. After a period of proven success (12 - 24 months), they become eligible to join our worker ownership program.

We've grown to roughly 265 people working onsite from our Menlo Park headquarters, supported by a large network of remote U.S.-licensed clinicians â and part of the Series C is earmarked for acquisitions. You'll own two halves of the same problem: the employee technology platform â identity, endpoints, networking, the SaaS portfolio, and our IT security posture â and the physical environment the company runs on, from space planning and physical security to the AV that customer demos and all-hands depend on. description:

At Tether, weâre not just building products, weâre pioneering a global financial revolution. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. 

Why Join Us? 

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. 

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. 

Are you ready to be part of the future? 

About the job 

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction. 

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. 

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself. 

Responsibilities 

- Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference. 

- Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them. 

- Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it. 

Mandatory: 

- Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps. 

- Strong product sense : you can tell a good feature from a busy one. 

- Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints : model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away. 

- You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities. 

- Deep JavaScript and React . 

- Initiative, curiosity, resilience , and the ability to give and receive direct critique. 

Preferred: 

- Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source .

title: Director Payment Integrity
description:
Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity 

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties: 

- Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management

- Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes

- Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements

- Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff

- Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA

- Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities

- Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights

- Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise

- Interact directly with customers as needed

- Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others

- Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs

- Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement: 

- B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation

- 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment

- Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements

- Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred

- Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis

- Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights

- Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers

- Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items

- Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines

- Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system

- Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
description:
About KIRA 

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own 

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

Â 

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Â 

Nice to have 

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Â 

Outcome 

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do 

- Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

- Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

- Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

- Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

- Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

- Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

- Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

- Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for 

- Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

- Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

- AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

- High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

- Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

- Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit 

- Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

- MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

- Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting 

- Competitive, top-of-market compensation

- You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

- Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

- Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
description:
About KIRA 

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own 

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

Â 

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Â 

Nice to have 

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Â 

Outcome 

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Team Lead Education
description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.** 

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com .

Role Overview 

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities 

- Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

- Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

- Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

- Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

- Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

- Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

- Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.

Required Experience 

- At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

- Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

- Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

- Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills 

- Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

- Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

- Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

- Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

- Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

- Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English .

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. About the Role 

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars. 

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design. 

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design. 

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered. 

What You Can Expect 

- 
Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars. 

- 
Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction. 

- 
The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking. 

- 
Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes. 

- 
A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers. 

- 
A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively. 

What We Are Looking For 

- 
7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable. 

- 
An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution. 

- 
Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing. 

- 
Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality. 

- 
Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams. 

- 
Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions. 

- 
Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows. 

- 
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers. 

- 
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft. 

- 
Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work. 

In This Role, You Will 

- 
Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery. 

- 
Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps. 

- 
Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes. 

- 
Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale. 

- 
Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment. 

- 
Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt. 

- 
Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction. 

- 
Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity. 

How You Work 

- 
You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you. 

- 
You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution. 

- 
You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer. 

- 
You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people. 

- 
You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates. 

- 
You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum. 

- 
You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

About the Role

This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

title: Marketing - First Hire (m/f/d), German Speaking
description:
About The Company 

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Yet many capital management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds - but struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren't built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so ManCos can launch and run ETFs at scale and compete effectively, helping broaden access to the market beyond dominant, US-based providers.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

The Role and What Makes It Special 

You own the two functions that decide how the outside world experiences NaroIQ: How we are perceived in the market, and who we manage to attract to build it. Marketing and Employer Branding sit together in one role at NaroIQ because the same narrative - sharp, technical, high quality - has to land with senior executives and journalists as well as with the engineers, operators and commercial talent we want to hire next.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will not manage a team of specialists who do the work - you'll do the work: drafting the LinkedIn post, creating our brand strategy, building relationships with journalists, organizing events, designing an employer brand. And you'll build the systems that let NaroIQ scale this without losing sharpness.

There is no marketing playbook to inherit and nobody above you in the function. You set the priorities, decide what not to do, and carry the call. That takes unusual self-drive - the kind where nobody has to ask you for a status update, and where an unclear brief is something you resolve rather than escalate.

You report to the CEO (Chris) and work in tight loops with Growth, Product and the leadership team. Over time, you have the opportunity to grow the function around you.

Tasks

What You'll Do 

PR & Events 

- Run PR campaigns end-to-end, directly and with external PR partners, to build durable credibility and secure consistent placements in tier-1 outlets (Handelsblatt, Bloomberg, FT) and the FinTech and asset-management publications that matter

- Build and maintain a working network of journalists and editors; develop narratives that sharpen NaroIQ's positioning

- Plan and coordinate events and speaking slots (e.g. Money20/20, FinTech and asset-management conferences, exclusive industry roundtables)

Content & Brand 

- Build a scalable content and thought-leadership engine that actively supports sales enablement and pipeline progression

- Grow NaroIQ's organic LinkedIn presence at the company and founder level. A steady cadence of substantive posts, not noise.

- Build and maintain a consistent brand identity across every surface: website, pitch deck, one-pagers, careers page, sales collateral

- Create a brand that sticks with our audience: You decide how we are perceived in the market and what the NaroIQ storyline should look like

Demand Generation & Sales Alignment 

- Develop the materials that prepare and accelerate enterprise conversations: one-pagers, decks, whitepapers, case studies

- Build and run inbound growth motions: SEO, AI search optimization, and targeted growth experiments

- Close the loop with Sales: instrument what's working, kill what isn't, feed campaign learnings back into product and positioning

Employer Branding 

- Build NaroIQ's employer brand into a real asset: a careers narrative that pulls senior talent in, a candidate experience that earns referrals

- Position NaroIQ as one of the most attractive places to work in European FinTech; through content, events, founder presence, and glimpses into the lived experience of the team

Requirements

What We're Looking For 

(You don't need to know it all - but you should be ready to dive in, learn fast, and take initiative.) 

- Experience in B2B marketing: Ideally in financial services or at an AI / enterprise startup

- You can create a brand, not just run one: you've built positioning and narrative for a product or category, ideally while the product was still moving

- Creative and strong at storytelling: You can draft an explanatory case study, a press pitch that lands, and a job description that pulls. Without slipping into FinTech buzzwords

- Extroverted and a strong communicator: You build real relationships with journalists, candidates and event coordinators

- Existing PR network or demonstrable track record in media work is a big plus

- Data-driven: You think in KPIs and processes, and use them to make the work sharper

- Experimental: You actively try new channels and formats, like AI search, new social formats, distribution plays

- You treat candidates as an audience: you can write a role description that makes people apply, shape how NaroIQ shows up to talent, and equip hiring managers with a story worth telling

- A taste-led approach to brand: you can hold a consistent visual and verbal system across surfaces and push back on output that breaks it

- Structured and genuinely self-directed: you're comfortable operating with ambiguity, high ownership and no cover in a small, fast-moving team

- Fluent in English and German, written and spoken

Nice to have: existing relationships with FinTech or asset-management journalists; experience building a careers brand from scratch; familiarity with growth tooling (SEO, attribution, growth-hacking stacks).

Why NaroIQ 

We're building something ambitious - and we believe the only way to do that is with a team that's low-ego, high-impact, and genuinely excited about what they're doing.

Here's what we care about: 

🔑 High Ownership 
We trust you to take full responsibility for your work. That means freedom and also being the person others rely on when things get real.

🚫 No Bullshit, No Ego 
We're too small for politics, posturing or competing agendas. We care about doing the right thing, not being right.

🧘‍♂️ Flexibility 
Exceptional work doesn't require relocation or fixed office hours. Have dinner with your family. Get that dog. Move to the Alps. We're remote-first and trust people to manage their own time.

🧳 Sometimes We Leave the House 
We do make time for real-life moments, like quarterly offsites or in-person team sessions, to solve stuff together or just hang out.

🦸🏻‍♀️ Hire for Spikes 
We don't expect you to be good at everything. We care about your superpower. We're building a team of nerds who are world-class in wildly different areas.

🛠 Default to Rethink 
We don't accept "that's just how it is." We dig deep, think from scratch and always believe there's a better way. First Principles isn't a buzzword for us.

QESTIT ist ein auf Qualitätssicherung spezialisiertes Beratungsunternehmen mit Fokus auf Testmanagement und Organisationsberatung entlang des gesamten Software Development Lifecycle, SAP und Non-SAP, mit und ohne KI. Als Teil der international aufgestellten QESTIT Group sind wir in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz, Schweden, Frankreich und Ägypten tätig. In Deutschland arbeiten wir aus Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Köln, Görlitz und München.

Deine Rolle

Wir entwickeln uns weiter: vom operativen Testmanagement hin zur Organisations- und Prozessberatung rund um die Qualitätssicherung im gesamten SDLC. Testing bleibt dabei unser Kern. Unsere Beraterinnen und Berater arbeiten meist allein oder in kleinen Teams direkt beim Kunden. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Als Engagement Lead verantwortest du die Ergebnisse und die Kundenzufriedenheit ausgewählter Accounts im DACH-Raum. Du setzt neue Kundensituationen methodisch auf, steuerst laufende Vorhaben als Projektleitung, auch wenn der Kunde diese Rolle nicht separat beauftragt, und baust die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden gezielt aus. Deine Rolle ist an Accounts und Projekten ausgerichtet, nicht an einer Region.

Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung und bist Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung der QESTIT GmbH. Du führst fachlich, die disziplinarische Führung liegt bei unseren Delivery-Center-Leitungen, mit denen du eng und auf Augenhöhe zusammenarbeitest. Perspektivisch kann die Rolle um disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung wachsen.

Deine Aufgaben

Projekte und Accounts steuern

- Du übernimmst für deine Bestandskunden die Projektleitung und steuerst Scope, Budget, Timeline und Risiken im Rahmen der Projektverträge

- Du setzt neue Kundensituationen methodisch auf: Zielbild, Vorgehen (klassisch, agil oder hybrid) und Team-Setup

- Du legst das methodische Vorgehen in deinen Projekten fest und gibst den Teams die Richtung bei der Erarbeitung der Ergebnisse gemeinsam mit dem Kunden vor

- Du sicherst die Qualität zentraler Liefergegenstände, bevor sie an den Kunden gehen, und gibst sie frei

Team anleiten und Standards setzen

- Du leitest unsere Beraterinnen und Berater fachlich und methodisch an und coachst sie in ihren Einsätzen

- Du meldest Staffing-Bedarfe für deine Accounts an und entscheidest bei der Besetzung deiner Projekte maßgeblich mit

- Du entwickelst Standards, Playbooks und Templates und sorgst für einheitliche Qualitätsstandards über deine Projekte hinweg

Kunden entwickeln und transparent berichten

- Du erkennst Wachstumspotenzial in deinen Accounts und hebst es gemeinsam mit unserem Sales-Team

- Du gestaltest Angebote für deine Accounts aktiv mit

- Du berichtest der Geschäftsführung regelmäßig über den Status deiner Accounts

- Du sprichst Risiken früh und offen an und eskalierst, wenn nötig, gegenüber der Geschäftsführung und gegenüber dem Kunden

Dein Profil

Fachlich

- Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in Qualitätssicherung, Testmanagement und Beratung mit, idealerweise in einem Beratungsunternehmen

- Du hast QA-Tiefe über den gesamten SDLC, von der Schnittstelle zum Requirements Engineering bis zur Testprozessreife

- Du hast Erfahrung im SAP-Testmanagement (SAP Activate, Solution Manager bzw. Focused Build) und ebenso belastbare Erfahrung in Non-SAP-Projekten

- Du setzt KI in der Qualitätssicherung gezielt ein, etwa bei der Testdatengenerierung oder im autonomen Testen

Methodik und Projektmanagement

- Du bist in klassischen und agilen Vorgehensmodellen (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) gleichermaßen sicher und wählst situativ, was zur Reife des Kunden passt, in der Praxis meist hybrid

- Du beherrschst das Handwerk der Projektsteuerung: Scope, Risiken, Budget und Stakeholder

- Du hast Erfahrung in Organisations- und Prozessberatung und im Change Management, von der Ist-Aufnahme bis zu Zielbild und Roadmap

Persönlich

- Du führst ohne disziplinarische Linie: Du coachst, moderierst Konflikte und gibst Struktur

- Du trittst souverän auf Entscheiderebene auf und hast ein unternehmerisches Gespür für Potenziale im laufenden Projekt

- Du kommunizierst klar und ehrlich, auch wenn die Nachricht unbequem ist

- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und sehr gut Englisch

- Du bist bereit, im DACH-Raum zu unseren Kunden zu reisen

Von Vorteil

- Zertifizierungen wie PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 oder SAFe; sie sind für uns ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung

- Erfahrung in der Beratung von Kunden in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz

Was dich bei uns erwartet

- Eine neu geschaffene Schlüsselrolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst, wie wir Beratung bei QESTIT liefern

- Eine klare Entwicklungsperspektive: Perspektivisch übernimmst du auch disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung

- Ein Platz in der Geschäftsleitung mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung

- Anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte im DACH-Raum, SAP und Non-SAP, mit und ohne KI

- Ein internationales Umfeld mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen in sechs Ländern

- Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein wertschätzendes, unkompliziertes Miteinander

Kontakt & Bewerbung

Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin.

title: Vertriebsmitarbeiter IT-Infrastruktur (m/w/d)
description:
Du redest gern mit Menschen, greifst lieber zum Hörer, als eine dritte E-Mail zu schreiben, und willst einen Kunden vom ersten Anruf bis zur Unterschrift selbst begleiten? Du willst nicht irgendetwas verkaufen, sondern eine IT, die danach wirklich läuft? Dann passt du zu uns.

Ob Berufseinsteiger oder erfahrener Vertriebler: Wichtiger als die Zahl deiner Berufsjahre ist uns, dass du zuhörst, dranbleibst und ehrlich berätst. Du musst kein Techniker sein. Was hinter Servern, Netzwerken und Cloud steckt, lernst du bei uns, mit Technikern, die bei Terminen an deiner Seite sind.

Wir sind MintCode Solutions aus Haselünne, ein Team aus 8 Leuten, das IT-Infrastruktur für Unternehmen in der Region baut und betreibt.

Aufgaben

- Du erschließt dein eigenes Kundengebiet und bist dafür verantwortlich.

- Du betreust deine Kunden vollständig selbst, von der Kaltakquise bis zur finalen Unterschrift: Es gibt keine Übergabe an einen anderen Vertriebler

- Du verkaufst unsere gesamte IT-Infrastruktur: Server, Netzwerke, Cloud in deutschen Rechenzentren, Microsoft 365 und laufende Betreuung

- Du planst selbst, welche Unternehmen du in deinem Gebiet ansprichst, und gehst aktiv auf sie zu, per Telefon, über LinkedIn, auf Veranstaltungen und über dein Netzwerk

- Du führst Erstgespräche, online und vor Ort, verstehst, wo beim Kunden der Schuh drückt, und nimmst den Bedarf sauber auf

- Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Technikern die passende Lösung und erstellst das Angebot

- Du fasst nach, verhandelst und holst die Unterschrift

- Du bleibst auch nach dem Auftrag der Ansprechpartner deiner Kunden und baust dein Gebiet Schritt für Schritt aus

- Du pflegst deine Kontakte und Gespräche so, dass jeder im Team den Stand nachvollziehen kann

- Du bringst zurück ins Team, was Kunden fragen und brauchen, und redest bei unserem Angebot mit

Du baust den Vertrieb bei uns mit auf und hast entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Und du stehst nicht allein da: Bei technischen Fragen ist immer ein Kollege da, der mit in den Termin kommt oder mit dir draufschaut.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

- Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung, ein Studium oder vergleichbare Praxis, Quereinsteiger sind willkommen

- Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und telefonierst gern, auch mit Leuten, die dich noch nicht kennen

- Du hörst zu, fragst nach und erklärst Dinge so, dass sie beim Gegenüber ankommen

- Du bleibst dran, auch wenn es beim ersten und zweiten Anruf noch kein Ja gibt

- Du führst Gespräche zu einem Ergebnis und scheust dich nicht, nach dem Auftrag zu fragen

- Du interessierst dich für IT und hast Lust, dich in technische Themen einzuarbeiten

- Du arbeitest strukturiert und hältst, was du Kunden zusagst

- Du sagst offen, was du denkst, auch gegenüber Kunden, wenn eine Lösung nicht zu ihnen passt

- Führerschein Klasse B und Reisebereitschaft, weil du regelmäßig bei Kunden vor Ort bist

Schön, wenn du das schon kannst (sonst lernst du es bei uns):

- Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise in einem IT-Systemhaus oder bei einem IT-Dienstleister

- Erfahrung mit Angeboten, Verhandlungen und Abschlüssen

- Grundwissen zu Servern, Netzwerken, Cloud oder Microsoft 365

- Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System

- Ein Netzwerk zu Unternehmen in der Region

Für uns zählen Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Potenzial mehr als ein perfekter Lebenslauf. Wichtig ist, dass du ehrlich berätst und Lust hast, besser zu werden.

Benefits

Möglichkeit auf einen eigenen Firmenwagen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, einen eigenen Firmenwagen zu bekommen. So bist du für Kundentermine flexibel unterwegs und musst dir um dein eigenes Auto keine Gedanken machen.

Techniker an deiner Seite. Du verkaufst nichts, was hinterher keiner liefern kann. Unsere Techniker planen mit dir und kommen mit zum Kunden.

Moderne Tooling-Kultur. KI-gestütztes Arbeiten für Recherche, Angebote und Vorbereitung statt Zettelwirtschaft.

Wellpass oder Streaming-Abo. Sport in tausenden Studios deutschlandweit oder Spotify bzw. Netflix auf uns. Such dir aus, was zu dir passt.

Bildungsurlaub ist willkommen. Kein unangenehmes Gespräch, kein schlechtes Gewissen. Wer sich weiterbilden will, hat unsere volle Unterstützung.

Start-up-Flair. Kurze Entscheidungswege, echte Eigenverantwortung und eine Atmosphäre, in der Ideen mehr zählen als Hierarchien.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten. Leben und Arbeit muss man manchmal jonglieren. Dafür hast du bei uns Verständnis und Spielraum.

Das sehen wir als Standard an

- Ein modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz

- 30 Tage Urlaub

- 38-Stunden-Woche

Wenn du Vertrieb machen willst, bei dem du hinter dem stehst, was du verkaufst, dann bewirb dich bei uns!

title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Unsere Kunden sind Hausverwaltungen, die über Getmomo Kautions-, Miet- und Rücklagenkonten führen. Als Customer Success Manager begleitest du unsere Kunden dabei, Getmomo erfolgreich in ihren Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren und ihre Prozesse rund um Kautionen, Mieten und Rücklagen einfacher zu gestalten. Du bringst neue Kunden in unserer Software an den Start, bist für Fragen da, findest heraus, wo im Bestand Potenzial liegt, und entscheidest selbst, wie wir unsere Kunden informieren.

Auf einen Blick: 

- Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit

- Hybrid: 4 Tage pro Woche im Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg, 1 Tag remote

- Start: ab sofort

Das machst du bei uns: 

- Neue Kunden zum Laufen bringen: Sobald ein neuer Kunde startklar ist, lädst du zum Onboarding ein, hältst die Termine und begleitest die ersten Wochen, bis der Kunde sicher mit unserer Software arbeitet.

- Potenziale im Bestand finden: Du wertest mit unseren internen Tools aus, welche Kunden bisher nur einen Teil unserer Produkte nutzen, wo das größte Potenzial liegt, und wer jetzt angesprochen werden sollte. Daraus entwickelst du Kampagnen, führst die Gespräche und machst deinen Erfolg messbar. Du arbeitest dabei mit denselben Systemen wie unser Kontoeröffnungsteam: Salesforce, unser eigenes AI-natives ERP und KI-Assistenten.

- Du entscheidest, wie unsere Kunden informiert werden: Du entwickelst Formate, mit denen wir neue Produkte und Funktionen verständlich vermitteln. Dazu gehören Webinare, Mailings, Anleitungen und Hilfeartikel. Was gut funktioniert, testest du, misst die Ergebnisse und entwickelst es weiter.

- Fragen klären und Probleme lösen: Am Telefon und per E-Mail hilfst du Kunden bei Fragen zu unserer Software, zu Zahlungen und Zugängen. Dazu gehören auch laufende Anliegen im Bestand wie Online-Banking-Zugänge oder Kontoschließungen. Was du nicht selbst lösen kannst, gibst du an die richtige Stelle im Team und bleibst dran, bis der Kunde eine Antwort hat.

- Zuhören und weitergeben: Du holst Feedback ein, etwa über unsere Kundenumfrage, erkennst Muster und bringst sie ins Team. Mit dem Feedback unserer Kunden gestaltest du unser Produkt aktiv mit und kannst ihre Wünsche direkt in die Weiterentwicklung einbringen. So wirst du zum Wunscherfüller für unsere Kunden.

- Abläufe smarter gestalten: Du erkennst, wo wir Abläufe vereinfachen, automatisieren oder mit KI besser lösen können, und setzt diese Ideen gemeinsam mit dem Team um. So machst du unsere Arbeit effizienter und schaffst mehr Zeit für unsere Kunden.

Woran du deinen Erfolg merkst: 

- Neue Kunden arbeiten schnell und sicher mit unserer Software.

- Bestandskunden nutzen unser gesamtes Produktportfolio.

- Unsere Kunden empfehlen uns weiter.

Das bringst du mit: 

- Ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung, zum Beispiel in BWL, Kommunikation, bei einer Bank oder in der Immobilienwirtschaft. Quereinstieg ist ausdrücklich willkommen.

- Erste Berufserfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management, Vertrieb oder Kundenbetreuung, idealerweise mit Geschäftskunden.

- Du arbeitest gern mit Zahlen und ziehst aus einer Auswertung die richtigen Schlüsse.

- Du stehst gern vor Leuten, auch digital, und erklärst Dinge so, dass sie hängen bleiben.

- Du hast ein Gespür dafür, was Kunden brauchen, auch wenn sie es nicht direkt sagen.

- Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, komplexe Themen einfach und verständlich zu erklären, schriftlich genauso wie im direkten Kundenkontakt.

- Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools und hast Lust, Abläufe damit zu automatisieren.

- Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englisch.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wie du arbeitest, ist uns wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf.

Das bekommst du bei uns: 

- Festanstellung in Vollzeit.

- Freiraum: Wie wir unsere Kunden informieren und welche Formate wir dafür nutzen, gestaltest du selbst.

- Eigene Kunden und eigene Projekte ab dem ersten Monat.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und regelmäßiges Feedback.

- Hybrides Arbeiten: 4 Tage im Büro in Berlin, 1 Tag remote, dazu 60 Tage Work from Anywhere.

- Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, ein Büro in der Oranienstraße in Kreuzberg, kostenlose Getränke und regelmäßige Team-Events.

Das klingt nach dir? 
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Bewirb dich ganz einfach über den Button auf dieser Seite.

title: HSE Manager (m/w/d) - deutschlandweit

description:
Über XCNT

XCNT baut Software mit einem digitalen Herzen und einer industriellen Seele als digitaler Produktbuilder der PARIGROUP SE. Die Ideen entstehen innerhalb dieser europäischen Herstellergruppe und werden so gestaltet, dass sie darüber hinaus skalieren. 

Wir bei XCNT arbeiten daran, künstliche Intelligenz im Unternehmensalltag nutzbar zu machen. Gemeinsam mit den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe identifizieren wir passende Anwendungsfälle, entwickeln unsere KI-Angebote weiter und unterstützen Mitarbeitende dabei, sie sinnvoll einzusetzen.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele Tools vorzustellen. Wir wollen konkrete Probleme lösen und KI dort in Arbeitsabläufe integrieren, wo sie wirklich hilft.

Dafür suchen wir dich: Du hast Freude an Technologie, gehst offen auf Menschen zu und möchtest gemeinsam mit ihnen herausfinden, wie KI ihre tägliche Arbeit verbessern kann.

Deine Aufgaben im Bereich AI Enablement & Adoption

Du machst aus ersten KI-Experimenten eine hilfreiche Routine.

Ob im persönlichen Austausch, in abteilungsspezifischen Workshops oder gemeinsam mit unseren AI Champions: Du hilfst Mitarbeitenden, passende Anwendungen zu finden, Hürden zu überwinden und KI selbstständig einzusetzen. Gleichzeitig bringst du ihre Erfahrungen und Anforderungen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer internen KI-Plattform auf Basis von OpenWebUI ein.

AI Enablement & Adoption – rund 70 %

- Im Alltag unterstützen: Du bist Ansprechperson für Fragen zur KI-Nutzung. Du hilfst bei konkreten Problemen und bindest bei Bedarf die richtigen Fachleute ein.

- Abteilungsspezifische Workshops gestalten: Du bereitest Workshops auf Deutsch und Englisch vor und führst sie durch – mit echten Aufgaben der jeweiligen Teams statt allgemeiner Tool-Demos.

- AI Champions unterstützen: Du begleitest engagierte Mitarbeitende, die KI in ihren Bereichen voranbringen, und unterstützt ihren Austausch untereinander.

- Anwendungsfälle gemeinsam entwickeln: Du findest mit den Teams heraus, wo KI sinnvoll unterstützen kann, erprobst passende Ansätze und begleitest die ersten Schritte im Alltag.

- Wissen zugänglich machen: Du bereitest hilfreiche Beispiele, Anleitungen und Best Practices so auf, dass andere sie direkt nutzen können.

- Dranbleiben: Du fragst nach, ob Lösungen tatsächlich helfen, und erkennst, wo weitere Unterstützung nötig ist.

Dazu gehört auch der gelegentliche Austausch vor Ort in den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe. Die Stelle ist also mit Reisen verbunden (DE/Europa).

Nutzerbedürfnisse & Produktanforderungen – rund 30 %

- Bedarf verstehen: Du sammelst Feedback aus Workshops, Support-Anfragen und Gesprächen mit unseren AI Champions.

- Anforderungen für OpenWebUI formulieren: Du beschreibst nachvollziehbar, welches Problem gelöst werden soll, für wen es relevant ist und was eine hilfreiche Lösung leisten muss.

- Muster erkennen: Du unterscheidest zwischen einzelnen Rückfragen, Schulungsbedarf und wiederkehrenden Produktanforderungen.

- Verbesserungen begleiten: Du stimmst Anforderungen mit dem technischen Team ab, testest neue Funktionen aus Nutzersicht und erklärst sie den Mitarbeitenden.

Du musst dafür keine vollständigen Softwarelösungen allein entwickeln. Wichtig ist, dass du technische Zusammenhänge verstehst und zwischen Anwendern und Entwicklung vermitteln kannst.

Dein Profil

- Du bist eingeschrieben, idealerweise am Anfang deines Masterstudiums – beispielsweise in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang im ersten oder zweiten Semester.

- Du nutzt generative KI bereits praktisch und kannst erklären, wo sie hilfreich ist und wo ihre Grenzen liegen.

- Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu, hörst aufmerksam zu und fragst nach, bevor du eine Lösung vorschlägst.

- Du kannst technische Themen verständlich vermitteln und hast Freude daran, andere beim Lernen zu unterstützen.

- Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenständig und behältst offene Fragen im Blick.

- Du bringst ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Software und webbasierte Anwendungen mit.

- Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erste Erfahrungen mit OpenWebUI, Workshops, Anwendersupport, Anforderungsmanagement oder Automatisierung.

Deine ersten Monate

Woran du merkst, dass du einen guten Job machst

- Mitarbeitende kommen bei ihren konkreten Aufgaben weiter – durch deine Unterstützung oder weil du sie an die richtige Stelle vermittelt hast.

- Teams nutzen KI nach einem Workshop eigenständig und sinnvoll weiter.

- Wiederkehrende Hürden werden sichtbar und fließen als klare Anforderungen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer KI-Plattform ein.

Kurz: Nicht die Zahl deiner Workshops zählt, sondern ob deine Arbeit den Alltag der Menschen verbessert.

Was die Rolle besonders macht

- Du verbindest Technologie, Zusammenarbeit und praktische Problemlösung.

title: Product Designer (m/f/x)
description:
UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world’s leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group. 

We are looking for a Product Designer (m/f/x) to join our Design Team in Berlin. You will be the design partner for one of our product teams, working alongside a Product Manager and engineers to take work from an early idea through to something people use. You will own your projects, hold a high quality bar on complex, data-rich interfaces, and work inside a design system you help keep healthy. 
You will enjoy this role if you want real ownership of a product area without carrying a whole platform, and if you like going deep into a genuinely complex domain. Our team is complementary, so your work is visible and the feedback loop is short.

What you will do: 

- Take design work from an early idea through to delivery, proposing solutions to blockers rather than only reporting them. 

- Be the reliable design partner for your product team: the person your PM and engineers come to first. 

- Design for complexity: dense data tables, long-running processes, and workflows where the edge cases matter as much as the main path. 

- Look for evidence before you design: talk to users, read what support and sales already know, look at how the product is actually used, and run tests on your own work. 

- Push to understand the problem before designing a solution, and say so when a brief arrives already shaped as one. 

- Scope your own features, break them into pieces, be roughly right about how long they will take, and flag delays early with a plan B rather than a warning. 

- Contribute to our design system, as everyone on our team does: propose and build components, not only use them. 

- Share your work cross-functionally, take feedback, and iterate; notice improvements inside your area and act on them, instead of waiting to be asked. 

Here is a good summary of what we are looking for: 

- Experience delivering product design work end-to-end inside a cross-functional team. 

- Solid interaction (IxD) and visual/UI design skills, with the ability to make complex data and workflows understandable. 

- Strong Figma skills, and a working understanding of how a design system is actually built: how a component is structured, how it behaves, and the rules it has to respect. You will be a contributor to ours, not only a user of it. 

- Experience using research and product evidence to make design decisions: usability tests, customer conversations, support tickets, product data. We are not looking for one particular method. 

- Comfortable telling the difference between what we know and what we are assuming, and willing to say which is which. 

- Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make progress when the picture is still incomplete, and to adjust when what you learn changes the direction. 

- Able to scope your own work and communicate honestly about time, collaborative, feedback-driven, and proactive about the problems you can see. 

- Fluent in English and based in Berlin with hybrid work capability. 

Bonus points if you bring: 

- Experience designing geospatial, enterprise, or data-heavy B2B products. 

- Background in UX research, data visualization, or complex workflow design. 

- Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design. 

- Experience with interactive prototyping. 

- Awareness of current AI tools and emerging opportunities in UX processes, with an understanding of how AI can enhance user outcomes without adding unnecessary complexity. 

Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice: 

- Let’s disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective 

- Let’s stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year 

- Let’s win as a team: We’re an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment 

- Let’s be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, an educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few 

- Let’s enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year 

- Let’s think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership

Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English. 

Our culture is one of belonging, where everyone feels welcome and where differences are celebrated. We seek to recruit the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background and/or belief—and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We also value more than the skills and experiences outlined in this job description. Even if you think you only fill 60% of the requirements for this role - we would still like to consider your application.
