title: Branch Support Manager - Europe
description:
About Rain for Rent International

Rain for Rent International provides innovative tank systems for liquid management applications. As an internationally operating rental and service company, expertise centers on rental, logistics, and services around the tank, focusing on the core competencies of renting storage tanks, containment systems, pumps, and filtration units.

Your role

We are looking for a hands-on Branch Support Manager ( m/f/d ) to help our teams across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France get the best from our business systems, processes and support functions.

This is not a traditional IT Manager position.

It is a highly business-facing role combining business systems, operational processes, user support, training, continuous improvement and team leadership . You will work closely with our branches and Shared Services teams to understand how people work, where they encounter challenges and how technology and better processes can make their jobs easier and our business more effective.

What you will do 

Become a Business Systems Expert 

You will develop strong expertise in the applications supporting our European operations and become a trusted point of contact for our business users.

A major focus will be our ERP environment, supporting processes such as:

- Purchasing and purchase orders

- Goods and invoice receipt

- Rental contracts

- Equipment on-hire and off-hire

- Recurring and final billing

- Credit notes and ad-hoc invoicing

- Customer, supplier and item master data

You will also support the effective use of CRM, Microsoft 365 and other operational applications.

Experience with inspHire, Zoho or Twinfield would be advantageous, but previous knowledge of our specific applications is not essential if you have strong ERP/business systems experience and learn quickly.

Help People Get the Best From Technology 

You will work directly with colleagues across our branches to understand challenges, answer questions and identify better ways of working.

That includes:

- Providing practical systems and process support

- Training new and existing users

- Developing SOPs, quick-reference guides and training materials

- Creating screen recordings and short training videos

- Building a structured, version-controlled knowledge library

- Identifying recurring problems and addressing their root causes

Most importantly, you will explain the why , not only the how .

Connect Systems With Business Reality 

Good systems only create good information when they are used correctly.

You will therefore work closely with Operations, Sales, Finance, Fleet and other Shared Services functions to improve the quality and consistency of the processes behind our data.

You will help us ensure that operational information, CRM pipelines, rental transactions, margins and management KPIs accurately reflect what is happening in the business.

Listen, Challenge and Improve 

Our branches know their business and will bring you ideas and requirements.

Your job is not simply to say yes.

You will listen, understand the underlying need and assess whether the best answer is a change to a system, process, training or something else.

For larger initiatives, you will help structure requirements, assess benefits, costs, effort and risks, and make clear recommendations to leadership.

Lead a Small Team 

You will lead a developing Branch Support function, expected to include approximately three team members across business support and IT/helpdesk activities .

This remains a hands-on role. You will lead the team while actively participating in support, training, problem solving and improvement initiatives yourself.

Stay Curious 

Technology is changing quickly and we want to take advantage of it.

You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious about tools such as Microsoft Copilot , automation and new ways technology can help colleagues work more effectively.

The Person We Are Looking For 

Systems knowledge matters, but how you work with people matters just as much.

You are someone who:

- Listens before proposing a solution

- Is patient and enjoys explaining things

- Can train and support colleagues with different levels of systems experience

- Builds credibility and strong working relationships

- Can persuade and influence without relying on hierarchy

- Is comfortable constructively challenging a request

- Is pragmatic and realistic about priorities, resources and costs

- Learns new business processes quickly

- Enjoys solving problems

- Is comfortable being visible and close to the operational business

- Is curious about technology and AI

You should be equally comfortable discussing a process with a branch administrator, working through a systems problem with IT, understanding a commercial requirement from Sales or presenting a recommendation to leadership.

European Scope 

The role supports operations across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France .

Regular interaction with the branches is a fundamental part of the position. You should therefore be willing to travel across our European locations , build strong relationships with local teams and spend time understanding how our operations work in practice.

Regular office presence is also expected, currently anticipated at up to three days per week at our office in Potsdam.

Why This Role? 

This is an opportunity to shape a developing European support function rather than simply inherit an established helpdesk.

You will have the opportunity to influence:

- How we use our business systems

- How we support and train users

- How processes are standardised across countries

- How knowledge is documented and shared

- How new technology and AI are adopted

- How Branch Support develops as our European organisation evolves

If you enjoy bringing together people, processes and technology and want a role where you can see the practical impact of your work across the business, we would like to hear from you.

Rain for Rent International is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive working environment and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, age, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER 

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics. 

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS 

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

- Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS 

- Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible 

- Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably 

- Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms 

- Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability 

- Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls 

- Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives 

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED 

- 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments 

- Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting 

- Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments 

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflows Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainability Experience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutions Deep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. 

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional: 

- Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure

- Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.

- Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services

- Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) 

- Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) 

- Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE 

- In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.

- In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT? 

- We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.

- We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 

- We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.

- Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness. 

- We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

title: AI/ML Researcher
description:
Über YLAB

Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden.

Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene.

Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten.

Warum YLAB

Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard.

Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt.

Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt.

Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch.

Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden.

Was wir bieten

- Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht.

- Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst.

- Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt.

- Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln.

Über die Rolle

Wie versteht ein Sprachmodell eine Vierjährige? Und wie erklärt es ihr die Welt, ohne sie zu überfordern? Dazu gibt es kaum Paper und keine Benchmarks. Genau da setzt du an.

Du bist unsere erste dedizierte Research-Stelle. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von KI, Sprache und Pädagogik, mit echten Familien statt Laborbedingungen und mit direktem Draht ins Produkt.

Was dich erwartet: offene Fragen mit Substanz, ein Fachbeirat aus Bildung und Psychologie und die Freiheit, Studien so zu bauen, wie sie sein müssen.

Wie du uns helfen kannst

- Du entwirfst und machst Studien mit Kindern und Familien. Von der Beobachtung im Wohnzimmer bis zum strukturierten Test.

- Du baust Methoden, um altersgerechte Antworten zu bewerten: Was heißt verständlich, was heißt zu viel?

- Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Modell- und Produktentscheidungen, zusammen mit Engineering und Pädagogik.

- Du behältst die Forschung im Blick (Child-Computer Interaction, Speech, LLM-Evals) und holst rein, was uns weiterbringt.

- Du teilst, was wir lernen. Wir forschen nicht für die Schublade.

Melde dich, wenn:

- Du hast einen Research-Hintergrund, etwa HCI, Psychologie, Linguistik oder ML.

- Du hast schon mit Nutzer:innen geforscht, am besten mit Kindern.

- Du kannst beides: Interviews auswerten und saubere Metriken bauen.

- Du schreibst klar. Für Paper genauso wie für Produktentscheidungen.

- Du magst es, wenn deine Forschung nächste Woche im Prototyp steckt.

Eher nicht, wenn: du Forschung als Selbstzweck siehst oder zwei Jahre Vorlauf brauchst, bevor etwas testbar ist.

- Python ist dein Zuhause und TypeScript schreckt dich nicht.

- Du triffst lieber Entscheidungen, als auf fertige Specs zu warten.

- Du willst, dass deine Arbeit im Kinderzimmer ankommt und nicht im Backlog.

- Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht.

- Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst.

- Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt.

- Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln.

Über die Rolle

Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern, näher dran geht nicht. Founder Associate heißt bei uns: Du bist die Feuerwehr. Wo es brennt, bist du zuerst da, egal ob Investor-Update, Prototypen-Logistik oder der Messestand am Freitag.

Dafür bekommst du den ehrlichsten Crashkurs in Company Building, den wir kennen: Du sitzt in den Entscheidungen, nicht im CC. Was du hier in einem Jahr siehst, sehen andere in fünf.

Geht in Vollzeit oder als Werkstudent:in. Uns ist egal, was auf deinem Vertrag steht, solange du Verantwortung willst.

Wie du uns helfen kannst

- Du räumst weg, was die Gründer bremst: Recherchen, Entscheidungsvorlagen, Angebote, Ämterpost, Orga.

- Du springst dahin, wo es gerade brennt, von Operations über Events bis zum Support für unsere Testfamilien.

- Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor: Zahlen ziehen, Optionen sortieren, klare Empfehlung dazuschreiben.

- Du baust kleine Prozesse und Tools, damit dasselbe Feuer nicht zweimal ausbricht.

- Du hältst die Fäden zu Partnern und Lieferanten zusammen, wenn es schnell gehen muss.

Melde dich, wenn:

- Du willst in einem Jahr mehr lernen als andere in fünf.

- Du erledigst Dinge, bevor jemand fragt, ob sie schon erledigt sind.

- Chaos macht dich nicht nervös. Du machst Listen draus.

- Du schreibst klar und schnell, auf Deutsch und auf Englisch.

- Du bist Generalist:in aus Überzeugung und lernst Neues schneller, als Stellenprofile es erlauben.

- Du studierst noch oder bist gerade fertig? Passt. Erfahrung schlägt Etikett.

Eher nicht, wenn: du eine Jobbeschreibung brauchst, die stimmt. Deine ändert sich hier jede Woche. Oder wenn du Feuer lieber meldest, als es zu löschen.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Buyer
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Buyer Domain at Vinted is dedicated to creating a seamless and highly engaging experience for our members as they search, discover, and purchase items. Our challenge is unique: unlike standard e-commerce, our peer-to-peer catalogue consists of hundreds of millions of entirely unique, single-inventory listings, with millions of new items uploaded daily. Connecting the right buyer with the perfect item in real-time is at the very core of Vinted's success.

The CVP team owns the core platform and services that govern how content is geofenced, balanced, and surfaced across Vinted's growing international network of markets. We build robust systems and tooling that manage cross-border visibility, enabling smooth and gradual market connections (e.g., FR-DE, BE-FR-ES) while optimising key liquidity metrics like Sell-Through Rate (STR%) and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) by balancing the content in multiple channels.

Our team works closely with Content Visibility Management, Search, and Recommender relevance teams to accelerate product development. Currently, we are driving the automation of content visibility experimentation & analysis. Rather than having different content channels independently re-implement visibility controls, we are building a unified platform to provide autonomy to Decision Scientists. In addition, we are highly contributing in growing new large markets such as the USA and Australia.

In this position, you’ll 

- Drive technical execution: Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable, reliable, and secure backend systems to ensure efficient content visibility and search mechanisms.

- Guide technical decisions: Contribute to and challenge the technical direction of our backend services, leading system design reviews and ensuring high-quality, maintainable code.

- Scale features globally: Implement and shape A/B tested features that positively impact our 80+ million users. Code changes are rolled out instantly to production.

- Own your services: Monitor and improve backend service performance and stability. The team owns and monitors service-layer measurements (SLIs, SLOs, etc.) and has an on-call rotation which you will participate in.

- Lead team-level initiatives: Lead and drive technical initiatives within the team, while collaborating on domain-wide integrations with other engineering teams (such as Search and Recommender relevance teams).

- Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with engineering and product managers, analysts, and other stakeholders, facilitating clear communication within the team and across domains.

- Contribute to product direction: Provide technical feasibility assessments, identify technical risks, and provide effort estimations to help shape our team's product roadmap.

- Foster engineering excellence: Mentor, guide, and share knowledge with other engineers in the team to support their technical growth and promote collaborative best practices

About you 

- You have extensive experience in backend software engineering, with a proven track record of designing and building scalable, distributed, and highly available systems.

- You are highly proficient in backend development. We primarily use Go, Kotlin, Ruby, Python — while prior experience in these specific languages is beneficial, a strong foundation in modern backend engineering and a willingness to learn is what matters most.

- Experience with event streaming platforms like Kafka, Apache Flink, or others for real-time data processing and message queueing.

- A track record working with search engines, information retrieval and ranking optimisations technologies (e.g., Vespa, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch) is a high advantage. If not, we expect you to have a strong willingness and motivation to learn.

- You are enthusiastic about AI technologies, use AI tools daily in your work, and proactively learn and experiment with how to adopt AI to boost engineering outcomes.

- Strong understanding of continuous integration and deployment pipelines, with experience in tools like Jenkins for automating builds and deployments.

- Experience with observability and monitoring tools (we use Grafana, Kibana, and others) to keep services healthy and define SLIs/SLOs.

- Experience working with relational and in-memory databases.

- Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working with cross-functional peers (Product, Analytics, SRE).

- Experience in mentoring other engineers, providing constructive feedback, and promoting engineering best practices within your team.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

Work perks 

- The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

- 30 days of paid annual leave

- Newest MacBook models

- Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

- Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

- Lunch benefit per your workday

- Frequent team-building events

- A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

- Access to a discounted gym membership plan

- Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution

- Supplemental Private Health Insurance

- Life and Disability insurance

- A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport

- A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget 

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity 

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

Die jährliche Bruttogehaltsspanne für diese Position beträgt:

€87.600 — €118.500 EUR

Rubrik helps organisations in every major industry stay resilient against cyberattacks, insider threats and operational disruption, protecting the data that hospitals, banks and public institutions depend on every day. - Make the most of Rubrik’s regional marketing, events and partner activity by following up quickly on the interest it creates in your territory.

- Work with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development and partners to extend your reach, and meet customers in person to build lasting relationships.

- Learn from experienced colleagues through structured enablement and hands-on mentoring, and share what works with the German team in pipeline reviews and deal strategy sessions.

- Feed local market insight and competitive signals back to Rubrik’s leadership to shape how we go to market in Germany.

Experience You’ll Need 

- A track record of winning new business in B2B enterprise software or SaaS, with consistent quota attainment and self-generated pipeline.

- Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and engaging technical, security and executive buyers.

- Fluent German and professional English.

- A structured approach to qualification and pipeline management, with MEDDPICC or a comparable framework.

- Based in or near Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, Stuttgart or Munich, with willingness to travel regularly across your territory.

- A learning mindset: you seek feedback, adapt quickly and want to keep growing with the support of a hands-on manager.

Preferred Qualifications 

- Background in cybersecurity, data protection, backup/recovery or adjacent infrastructure and cloud categories. It’s not a must, since we’ll teach you the rest.

- Experience selling with channel partners.

- Knowledge of the industrial, financial and Mittelstand landscape in Western and Southern Germany.

- Familiarity with Salesforce for pipeline management and forecasting.

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About Sezzle: 

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation :

For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is $12,500 - $20,800 USD based on location and experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role: 

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, operate, and scale the platform that powers Sezzle. Your focus will be the hardest infrastructure problems: increasing throughput, reducing latency, removing capacity bottlenecks, strengthening resilience, and making production operations more automated and predictable as the business grows.

You will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. Your impact will come from the systems you build, the problems you solve, and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Our stack runs on AWS , with workloads orchestrated on Kubernetes and data anchored in Aurora RDS (MySQL and Postgres) . You should know these technologies deeply and be comfortable moving between cloud architecture, networking, cluster internals, database performance, and application behavior to understand how the entire system scales. You will write code and infrastructure-as-code, debug production systems, and deliver changes that hold up under real traffic and failure conditions.

Operational ownership is part of the job. You will participate in the on-call rotation and take a hands-on role in recovering from major incidents, including full outages. We need someone who can form and test hypotheses using logs, metrics, and traces, make sound mitigation decisions with incomplete information, and turn incident findings into lasting engineering fixes.

You will also build and apply AI-assisted infrastructure and SRE tooling for incident investigation, capacity analysis, runbook automation, and toil reduction. You will evaluate these tools through practical results and apply appropriate access controls, validation, and auditability to their use in production.

This role reports to engineering leadership and works closely with application engineers, Security, and Compliance. You will develop a deep understanding of how Sezzle's business operates and how customer journeys, transaction patterns, and product decisions shape infrastructure demand and behavior. You will use that understanding to identify and deliver improvements across teams and technical domains, connecting infrastructure decisions to better customer outcomes and business performance.

What you’ll do: 

- Own the technical architecture and evolution of core infrastructure : identify system limits, prioritize technical improvements, and implement changes that support increasing traffic, data volume, and workload complexity.

- Connect business understanding to improvements across the system : learn how key business workflows behave in production, trace their impact across applications, data, and infrastructure, and partner across teams to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency beyond any single service or team's scope.

- Engineer for scale and performance : build capacity models, run load and stress tests, diagnose bottlenecks across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and databases, and validate improvements against throughput, latency, saturation, and cost per workload.

- Design and build AWS infrastructure : implement resilient account, IAM, network, and service architectures; address service quotas, fault isolation, and multi-AZ or multi-region requirements as workloads grow.

- Build and operate the Kubernetes platform : improve cluster architecture, lifecycle automation, workload isolation, resource allocation, autoscaling, safe upgrades, and deployment reliability.

- Scale and optimize Aurora RDS for MySQL and Postgres : tune queries and indexes, address connection and replication bottlenecks, plan capacity, improve failover behavior, and implement safe schema changes and database migrations with application engineers.

- Improve reliability through engineering : define and instrument service-level objectives and error budgets with service owners; implement failure isolation, backpressure, load shedding, and safe retry behavior where needed to prevent cascading failures.

- Participate in on-call and drive technical recovery during serious incidents : use evidence-based triage, execute mitigations, communicate findings, and implement corrective actions from postmortems.

- Implement and test disaster recovery : design backup, restore, and failover mechanisms against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives; run recovery exercises and document measured results.

- Build infrastructure-as-code and operational automation : make provisioning, configuration, deployments, upgrades, and recovery reproducible, reviewed, testable, and recoverable. Eliminate recurring manual work through code.

- Build observability that makes production diagnosable : improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with visibility into service health, scaling limits, and customer impact.

- Deliver safe infrastructure migrations : design phased rollouts, compatibility checks, validation, and rollback paths for changes to shared production systems.

- Improve cloud cost efficiency through technical changes : right-size resources, improve utilization, tune autoscaling and storage, and quantify savings while maintaining reliability and performance targets.

- Build and evaluate AI-assisted operational tooling : apply AI to investigation, runbooks, anomaly analysis, and repetitive operations, with bounded permissions, reviewable actions, and measurable improvements in accuracy or toil.

- Make technical decisions clear and executable : write architecture proposals, evaluate technology tradeoffs through prototypes and benchmarks, review changes affecting shared infrastructure, and document how systems operate and fail.

What We look for: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required)

- 12+ years of experience across infrastructure, platform, site reliability, software development, or related engineering disciplines, with substantial hands-on depth designing and operating production infrastructure at scale.

- Deep expertise with AWS : production experience across compute, IAM, multi-account architectures, and networking, including VPC design and private connectivity.

- Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production : cluster lifecycle, scheduling, resource management, autoscaling, networking, and troubleshooting business-critical workloads. EKS experience is strongly preferred.

- Deep expertise with relational databases at scale , specifically RDS/Aurora (MySQL and/or Postgres) : query performance, indexing, connection management, replication, high availability, failover, and verified backup and recovery.

- A track record of personally delivering infrastructure scaling improvements : identifying constraints, measuring baseline behavior, implementing changes, and demonstrating gains in capacity, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency.

- Strong coding and automation skills , using Golang, Python, or similar languages to build production tooling and eliminate operational toil, alongside infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or equivalent.

- Strong systems fundamentals : Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, storage, concurrency, and distributed system failure modes, with the ability to debug problems across infrastructure and application boundaries.

- Experience operating a 24/7, high-availability platform where downtime has direct customer or revenue impact, including hands-on incident response and postmortem remediation.

- Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and demonstrated ability to recover production systems under pressure using evidence-based triage, safe mitigation, and clear technical communication.

- Experience implementing and testing disaster recovery against defined recovery objectives, including restoring data and validating service recovery.

- Practical experience with observability, load testing, capacity planning, and safe CI/CD practices for shared production infrastructure.

- Active use of AI tooling in engineering or operations , with practical judgment about its limitations and how to verify generated code, recommendations, and operational actions.

- Ability to carry ambiguous technical problems from investigation through production delivery and collaborate across engineering disciplines to resolve system-wide constraints.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills: 

- Experience in fintech, payments, or banking , operating infrastructure with demanding reliability, security, and audit requirements.

- Experience with multi-region architectures, chaos engineering, and failure testing , including the consistency and recovery tradeoffs of distributed data systems.

- Proficiency with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo , or comparable observability systems.

- Experience building internal platform capabilities and self-service tooling , including deployment automation, progressive delivery, and reusable infrastructure components.

- Experience building AI-assisted incident investigation or operational automation with restricted access, auditable execution, and clear human review points

- 

About You: 

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

- You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

- You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

- You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

- You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

- You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

- You go deep : you investigate how systems behave under load and failure, follow the evidence, and fix underlying causes.

- You build and ship : you turn architecture into working code, tested infrastructure, and safe production changes.

- You measure results : you can explain the impact of your work in availability, latency, capacity, recovery time, cost, or hours of toil

- Experience working within an international business or advising on privacy matters across multiple jurisdictions would be beneficial.

This is an opportunity to join an international technology business where privacy plays an important role in how the company operates, develops its products and works with customers.

You'll have a broad remit, working closely with different teams across the organisation on a range of commercial, operational and regulatory matters, including some of the challenges emerging technologies bring to data protection.

If you're a privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, has an interest in technology and takes a practical approach to solving legal challenges, we'd be interested in hearing from you.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you sell to the engineering leaders who cannot afford to get incidents wrong, and every deal you close is one more company that handles its worst day better.

What that looks like day to day

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you're selling into the biggest and most complex accounts we go after, the ones where an incident going badly becomes a board-level problem. Intercom, Etsy, Miro, HashiCorp and StubHub are already customers, so you're not cold-starting a story nobody believes. The product has real market fit and it is nowhere near fully capitalised. That gap is the whole opportunity.

The team you're joining are seasoned sellers who are as much strategic partners and product evangelists as they are closers. Enterprise cycles here mean six or seven decision-makers, technical buyers who will test you properly, and C-level conversations where you need to be credible immediately. You'll run demos alongside SE's, and the feedback you bring back goes to a product team that ships in hours and days, not quarters.

Sales isn't a function bolted onto the side of this business, it's central to how we win. You'll work with leadership on building sales process rather than inheriting a finished one, and challenging how we do things is the job itself, not something you get credit for on top.

We're AI-forward, founded by engineers, and everyone here has unlimited Claude access. We expect you to use it properly: researching accounts, prepping deals, and moving faster than the rep across the table at a legacy vendor.

Who you are

- You've closed $100k+ new business at the top end of enterprise, and you can talk me through how you actually did it, not just what the number was.

- You're comfortable in a room full of engineers and CTOs. Technical buyers don't faze you, and you know the difference between selling to them and selling at them.

- You're a proper hunter. You've got more than one way into an account, and a run of rejection doesn't take the wind out of you.

- You build the case with evidence. Data, the right customer story, real product knowledge, whatever it takes to move that particular stakeholder.

- Multi-threading is instinct, not technique. You assume there are six people on the other side of the deal and you'd rather know all of them.

- You've got opinions about the product and you share them. The best reps here are the ones product actually listens to.

- Startup ambiguity suits you. The playbook is half-written, nobody is going to hand you a process, and you'd rather help build one.

- You're good to work with. You'll be close to leadership, SEs and CSMs, and you care about being someone people want in the room.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

- Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

- Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

- First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

- Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

- Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

- Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

- Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

- Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Roku UI
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV 

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the team 

At Roku, the UI Systems team builds the high-performance engines and core graphics infrastructure that power millions of devices. We own the low-level C++ frameworks, rendering pipelines, and system architectures that enable smooth navigation and rich animations. Our work sits at the intersection of hardware and software, where we optimize graphics rendering, memory management, and layout engines to ensure a consistent, lightning-fast experience across our entire device portfolio. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment, partnering closely with firmware and silicon teams to push the boundaries of what’s possible on embedded hardware.

About the role 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key architect of the core systems that underpin Roku’s user experience. You will design and implement performance-critical code within our UI engine, focusing on graphics primitives, memory efficiency, and hardware acceleration. You’ll tackle complex systems-level challenges—such as optimizing frame rates on resource-constrained hardware and building robust APIs for higher-level frameworks. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive on low-level systems programming, care about performance down to the microsecond, and want to build the high-performance foundations that power the future of television.

What you’ll be doing 

- Architect and optimize core C++ UI frameworks and rendering engines to ensure buttery-smooth performance across a diverse range of hardware profiles.

- Lead technical investigations into system-level bottlenecks, memory leaks, and GPU/CPU synchronization issues.

- Develop and maintain low-level graphics APIs and layout systems that serve as the backbone for Roku’s application ecosystem.

- Integrate AI/ML capabilities at the systems level, leveraging generative AI tools to optimize code generation and automate performance profiling.

- Collaborate with firmware and driver teams to leverage hardware-specific optimizations and ensure seamless integration with the underlying OS.

- Mentor junior developers through deep-dive code reviews, architectural design sessions, and technical documentation of core systems.

- Drive engineering excellence by implementing advanced debugging tools, automated performance regression suites, and modern C++ best practices.

We’re excited if you have 

- Minimum of 5+ years of software engineering experience with a heavy focus on C++ (C++14/17/20).

- Deep understanding of systems programming, including memory management, multi-threading, and hardware-software abstraction layers.

- Experience with graphics APIs (e.g., OpenGL, Vulkan, or proprietary embedded graphics stacks) and rendering pipelines.

- Proficiency in Python for tooling and automation, with a working knowledge of BrightScript or JavaScript being a significant plus.

- Strong root cause analysis skills, specifically using tools like GDB, Valgrind, or platform-specific profilers.

- Knowledge of AI applications and hands-on experience using generative AI tools to accelerate systems-level development.

- A proactive mindset with a passion for squeezing every drop of performance out of embedded systems and a commitment to data-driven optimization.

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working? 

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits? 

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. About the role 

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to 

You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams.

What you’ll be doing 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will:

- Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination).

- Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance.

- Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.

- Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.

- Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.

- Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.

- Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.

- Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.

- Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more!

What you bring 

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure.

- A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.

- Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.

- Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.

- Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.

- Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).

- AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.

- Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.

- The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement.

- Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments.

Why is this role a good fit for you 

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers.

- You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements.

- You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy.

- You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team.

- You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them.

How you’ll develop in this role 

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

- Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised.

- Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it.

- Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary.

- You will work closely with the Complaints Team, to resolve complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, as well as be responsible for feeding back to both frontline and product teams on product and process improvements across the Operations Team and wider Lendable business.

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Direct Mail is one of our highest-potential channels and we’re hiring a leader to turn it into a scaled, precise, and defensible growth engine. We’re looking for a Head of Direct Mail to own the channel end-to-end: creative, sends, logistics, offers, and reporting, sourcing the data pipeline and user-data enrichment that let us target the right customer, with the right offer, at the right moment.

You'll lead the channel's dedicated analysts and work with our creative team. Your job is to set the direction: decide who we mail, with what offer and when, commission and challenge the selection and response models, and hold every campaign to CAC and LTV targets.

Standalone direct mail roles with this kind of budget and autonomy are rare. If you've got significant experience in acquisition mail and want to build a channel your own way, at a profitable business with the product range and analytical capabilities to make it work, this is the role.

What we’re looking for: 

Essential: 

- 5+ years in direct mail, including at least 2–3 years owning an acquisition DM programme end to end: strategy, budget, data, production and results.

- A track record of mailing cold prospects at meaningful scale. You'll be able to talk through the volumes, budgets, response rates and CPAs you've been accountable for.

- Experience procuring data: working with data suppliers on list selection, screening, enrichment and cost.

- Deep knowledge of the DM supply chain: print, lettershop, Royal Mail products (Advertising Mail, Mailmark, partially addressed, door drops) and suppression (MPS, goneaways, deceased).

- A strongly commercial approach. You build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, own the channel P&L, and measure spend on CAC, ROI and payback rather than pieces mailed.

- Strong analytical judgement. You design test cells and holdouts, read results critically, and understand response and propensity modelling well enough to brief analysts, challenge their work and turn it into mailing decisions.

- Experience managing suppliers: tendering, negotiating, setting SLAs and keeping several partners to schedule.

- The ability to run a multi-drop campaign calendar across products, segments, creative, compliance sign-off, production and mail dates.

- Experience leading analysts and working closely with creative teams.

- A clear communicator who earns the trust of finance, risk, compliance and data teams.

- Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow.

Desirable: 

- Experience in acquisition mail in financial services, especially credit cards or loans, including prescreened or pre-approved offers and risk-based targeting.

- Experience standing up a data pipeline or enrichment stack (first-party + third-party / bureau data)

- Experience building a channel or function from scratch

- Background hiring and developing an analytics or design team

You’re a good fit if you’re: 

- Acquisition-minded: you're energised by finding new customers, not re-contacting existing ones.

- Commercially driven: you measure success in incremental LTV and payback, not response rate alone.

- A first-principles thinker: you argue from data and clean experiments, not received wisdom

- Organised: you can run several drops across multiple suppliers and still hit mailing deadlines.

- Energised by greenfield: you’d rather build the engine than tune someone else’s

What you’ll be doing 

Strategy and commercials 

- Own the direct mail strategy and set volume, response and payback targets anchored to LTV.

- Own the channel P&L: forecasting, budget and CAC/LTV discipline.

- Decide how far and how fast to scale, based on the economics.

Data and targeting 

- Source and buy prospect data from bureaus and brokers, and combine it with our first-party data.

- Direct the analysts building the response and propensity models that decide who we mail, with what offer and when.

- Work with risk analysts to shape offers around eligibility and lifetime value.

Campaigns and supplier management 

- Plan and run the campaign calendar, from data selection to the mail landing on doormats.

- Select, negotiate with and manage print and postal suppliers on cost, quality and turnaround.

- Brief the creative team on packs, copy and offers, and take them through compliance sign-off.

Reporting & Team 

- Build the reporting that ties sends to funnel, revenue and LTV and report on channel performance

- Partner with data, product, risk, finance and the creative team to unlock targeting and offers

- Hire and develop the team as the channel scales, and use AI to let a small team punch above its weight

title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist (Viator)
description:
About Tripadvisor 

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

As our new Senior Machine Learning Scientist you’ll be joining the Viator R&D Team. This team is evolving the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

About the Role 

You’ll serve as a key technical lead and pod architect within our core discovery engine. You will independently own and execute the machine learning strategy for major product capabilities—such as Search, Retrieval, Ranking, or Content AI—that power how millions of users discover and plan their travel itineraries.

This Senior Machine Learning Scientist role bridges the gap between state-of-the-art (SOTA) research and robust, production-grade engineering. You will navigate technical ambiguity, implement custom algorithmic components, and explicitly map offline model metrics directly to business KPIs like booking conversion and user engagement. If you are a relentlessly curious scientist who excels at rapid prototyping, practical SOTA deployment, and multiplying the capabilities of your peers, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do 

- Technical Leadership & Custom Implementation: Act as the technical lead for specific ML projects within your pod. Design and implement custom model components or loss functions that don't exist "off-the-shelf," breaking down massive research goals into deliverable, iterative milestones.

- Optimization & SOTA Scouting: Evaluate the global research landscape to conduct cost-benefit analyses on new architectures, balancing model complexity against inference speed, memory usage, and execution costs (such as token consumption). Optimize models for production using techniques like quantization and distillation.

- Operational Frameworks & Rigor: Tailor Golden Datasets and leaderboards with minimal supervision, and implement rigorous validation automation (such as backtesting and slice-based evaluation) to prevent data leakage, over-fitting, and production regressions.

- Engineering Partnership & Handovers: Collaborate closely with Engineering Leads to ensure compute/GPU infrastructure supports model requirements. Clearly define model failure modes, edge cases, and confidence thresholds—to enable SWE partners to build robust fallback systems.

- Applied Debugging & Guardrails: Diagnose complex algorithmic bugs and implement automated checks for "Silent Failures" (e.g., concept drift or production feature distribution shifts). Lead team-level post-mortems and resolve blocking corrective actions.

- Career Multiplier: Formally mentor mid-level and associate ML scientists, reviewing their experimental logic to ensure high scientific rigor while guiding them through applied ML and production constraints.

Skills & Experience 

- Education: Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a highly quantitative field.

- Experience: 5+ years of industry experience developing, validating, and deploying large-scale ML models in production environments.

- Algorithmic Expertise: Strong practical and theoretical foundation in machine learning techniques, feature engineering, and deep learning paradigms.

- SOTA Adaptability: Proven ability to tweak, hybridize, and adapt existing state-of-the-art architectures to solve non-linear business problems. Experience with multi-task learning (MTL), ranking, Content AI stacks, Agentic AI etc is highly desirable.

- Technical Stack: Mastery of Python and deep learning frameworks (such as PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, or TensorFlow) alongside familiarity with data versioning and experiment tracking tools.

Desired 

- Next-generation retrieval pipelines, multi-stage ranking systems and Content AI stacks.

- Advanced sequential recommendation systems designed to model real-time user session dynamics.

- Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), knowledge graphs, and multi-modal representation learning to map travel entities.

- Generative AI and Agentic AI workflows to improve conversational discovery experiences.

What We Offer 

- Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses

- “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.

- Flexible schedule . Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.

- Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.

- Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.

- Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.

- Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.

- Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.

- Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.

- Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars: 

Traveler first 

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. 

Execution is our edge 

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. 

We succeed together 

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

title: Field Marketing Specialist
description:
About Dust 

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. 

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. 

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 .

This Role

The French market is one of Dust’s most important growth levers, and the Marketing team plays a central role in supporting pipeline generation through events, content and account-based activations.

As field marketing specialist, France, you will be the execution owner for Dust’s local Marketing activities. Working closely with the France Marketing Lead, you will turn defined priorities into high-quality events, localized webinars, social media, content and partner marketing activations that support Sales, BDRs and pipeline generation.

The France Marketing Lead owns the strategy, budget, programme selection and priorities. You will own execution, coordination, content delivery and continuous improvement across the French Marketing motion.

You will be part of a growing Marketing team across the US, UK and France, managed by the Global Head of Marketing.

Key Responsibilities

Own the execution of the French event and webinar programme

- Execute conferences, Dust-owned events and localized webinars selected and scoped by the France Marketing Lead.

- Coordinate the preparation, stakeholders, content, landing pages and logistics needed for a smooth delivery.

- Work closely with Sales and BDRs to prepare target accounts, follow-up plans and event-related content.

- Collect feedback, measure performance and document learnings after each activity.

Own French social media and content activation

- Own social media execution for Dust around events, campaigns and key French-market topics.

- Support AEs with relevant content and messaging for their LinkedIn activity.

- Coordinate with Global Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Design and external media partners to deliver relevant content for French enterprise audiences.

- Turn events, customer conversations and market insights into reusable content, including customer stories, blog posts, videos, YouTube content and Sales assets.

Support partner marketing and Growth programmes

- Provide execution and logistical support for regional partner marketing activities within the strategy, selection and budget defined by the France Marketing Lead.

- Support Growth with French-market content for ABM, webinars and paid campaigns.

- Produce or reformat assets such as e-books, landing pages, customer content and campaign materials.

- Connect event, content and partner marketing activities to target account engagement and pipeline generation.

Coordinate cross-functional Marketing initiatives

- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive Marketing tasks , Build Dust agents and workflows to support research, event preparation, content repurposing, Sales enablement, reporting and follow-up.

Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in B2B Marketing , ideally across Field Marketing, Event Marketing, Content Marketing or Product Marketing, preferably in SaaS or technology.

- End-to-end event ownership with the ability to plan and deliver conferences, executive events and Dust-owned events, from preparation through execution and post-event follow-up.

- Strong content and social media skills with experience creating or repurposing content for enterprise audiences across social media, landing pages, customer stories, YouTube, Sales enablement and executive LinkedIn profiles.

- Commercial and pipeline mindset with a clear understanding of how events, content and account-based activities support Sales, BDRs, direct pipeline and partner-led growth.

- Excellent communication skills in French and English , both written and spoken. You can write clearly and accurately, adapt your tone to different audiences and communicate credibly with enterprise executives.

- Generalist and hands-on approach . You are comfortable moving between event ownership, content creation, Sales preparation, webinars, campaign assets and operational coordination.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail . You anticipate needs, manage deadlines reliably and ensure that projects, events and content are properly prepared before launch.

- Self-starter mentality . You take initiative, make decisions, solve problems and own outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do.

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills . You know how to find and coordinate the right people across Marketing, Sales, BDRs, Customer Success, Partnerships and external partners.

- Nice to have: Experience marketing to French enterprise or CAC 40 audiences, working with agencies or media partners, supporting paid campaigns, producing webinars or video content, and working with tools such as HubSpot, Google Workspace and Figma.

- Location and travel: Based in Paris, comfortable working on-site and willing to travel occasionally for events in France.

What Makes This Role Unique

- Direct pipeline impact: Your work will directly support Sales and BDRs through events, content and ABM activations.

- Execution ownership in France: You will turn the priorities defined by the France Marketing Lead into high-quality events, content, social media and partner marketing activations in France.

- AI-native Marketing: You will use Dust to automate research, preparation, content production, reporting and follow-up.

- Generalist scope: The role combines events, content, social media, webinars, Sales enablement and ABM.

- Market-shaping opportunity: Help establish Dust as a leading voice in the French enterprise and agentic AI market.

Location 

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust 

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. 

Learn how we think and work.

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture .
