title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
HelloPrint is on a mission to become the world’s leading infrastructure for customizable printed products. From our offices in Rotterdam and Valencia, 100+ professionals from 20+ nationalities are building an AI-first company that scales output faster than headcount. We’re at €85M revenue and we’re aiming to 10x that in the next decade. Every hire we make needs to help get us there.

This is not a role where you take orders and pass on CVs. HelloPrint is reinventing itself, and every hire decides how fast that happens. You lead recruitment: you find out what the team really needs, source the people, sell them on HelloPrint and close the deal, using AI to reach more people, faster. You report to Hans (CEO) and Lizzy (VP People & Organization) and work independently with Hiring Managers. 

What you’ll do: 

- Lead recruitment end to end and independently, from intake to signed offer, for tech, e-commerce, growth, marketing and staff roles. 

- Work closely with hiring managers and ask the critical questions: do we need this role, what does the team actually need, and what does success look like? 

- Bring organization design into the process: role scope, team setup and how a hire fits the bigger picture. 

- Steer the process and the decisions. You set the pace and push for answers. 

- Source first. You find candidates yourself on LinkedIn, in communities and through your network. Agencies are a supplement, not the plan. 

- Sell HelloPrint, screen and guide candidates, and close the deal. Nobody is left waiting without an answer. 

- Build and improve AI workflows for sourcing, outreach and screening, on top of our existing AI screening. 

- Grow our employer brand through events and connections, and report on pipeline and results so everyone sees where hiring stands. 

What makes this role hard: you work independently, you challenge hiring managers who just want the role filled, and the range of profiles runs from engineers to marketers to staff.

What we’re looking for: 

Must-haves: 

- A few years of hands-on recruitment experience, with real self-sourcing behind it. 

- You are curious, a doer, and you move fast without full certainty 

- You can sell and close: you convince strong candidates and you get the deal done 

- You are confident enough to lead recruitment and to challenge hiring managers with critical questions 

- You think beyond the vacancy: you see how a role fits the team and the organization 

- You use AI in your daily work and you build with it (workflows, automations), not just prompt 

- Fluent English (written and spoken) - full time & 5 days in the office in Rotterdam. 

Nice to haves: 

- Dutch, but not necessary: HelloPrint is a truly international company 

- Experience hiring for tech, e-commerce, growth or marketing profiles 

- Experience with employer branding or recruitment events 

What we offer: 

- 🎯 Room to grow: opportunities develop fast, within your role and across HelloPrint 

- 🌍 International environment: work with 100+ professionals from 20+ nationalities in Rotterdam or Valencia 

- 🚀 Real impact: shape the future of a high-growth, AI-driven company where your ideas actually land

title: Data Platform Manager
description:
About the role 

As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week.

You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver.

At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive.

What You'll Do 

- Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
- Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people.
- Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do.
- Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source.
- Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business.
- Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence.
- Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge.
- Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question.
- Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake.
- Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us.
Requirements 

What You’ll Need 

Requirements 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field.
- 5-8 years of data engineering experience, including real ownership of a lakehouse architecture rather than only delivering against someone else's.
- Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience is strongly preferred — OneLake, lakehouses, Delta tables, the SQL analytics endpoint, Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks, and semantic models in Direct Lake mode. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously.
- Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does.
- Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL, solid PySpark, and comfort building and orchestrating pipelines yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams.
- Practical understanding of Fabric capacity: how workloads consume it, how to spot what is burning it, and how to keep the platform inside its envelope.
- Experience leading engineers — formally, or as a technical lead who set direction and mentored others. A first step into people management is welcome if the technical leadership is already there.
- Proven integration experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, as well as APIs, flat-file landings, and change data capture from operational databases.
- Solid data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling and an understanding of how a semantic layer serves Power BI.
- Working knowledge of lineage, data governance, and access control in a cloud platform; exposure to Microsoft Purview is a plus.
- Interest or experience in the data foundations behind AI assistants — retrieval, knowledge graphs, and preparing data so that an agent can answer with it.
- Aerospace or another regulated industry is an advantage; so is experience in a start-up or scale-up.
- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Who You Are 

You are an architect who never stops building. You have strong opinions about how a platform should be structured, and you earn the right to them by being in the code. You would rather make a design decision explicit and documented than let it live in one person's head.

You care more about reliability than novelty. You know that the measure of a data platform is whether people trust the numbers that come out of it on a Monday morning, not how modern the stack looks on a slide. When something breaks, you want to know why it was possible, not just how to patch it.

You enjoy growing engineers, and you understand that leading a small team means doing the work alongside them. Above all, you want to build something durable — a foundation that holds while the company scales on top of it.

title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Production & Quality)
description:
About the role 

Behind every well-run plant is a shared understanding of how it is performing — and that understanding has to be built. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Production & Quality at Destinus, you are the bridge between the people who run our plants and the data that describes them. Plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers own the processes; our lakehouse holds the data those processes create. Your job is to connect the two, so that every production and quality figure, from the shopfloor to the leadership team, is defined by the business, built on the lakehouse, and trusted by both.

This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what the business needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the production and quality data in the lakehouse and turning it into the reporting used across three European plants, including our Digital Shopfloor Management Solution, relied on by more than 300 people. You will also go to where the data is created and make it better there — improving how it is captured, automating what is still manual, and helping three plants work to one standard.

At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our operations span multiple plants and teams, and your work will directly support the reliability, efficiency, and excellence required for mission-critical production. Join us in shaping the next era of aerospace operations.

What You'll do 

- Be the go-to contact between the business owners of production and quality data — plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on.

- Own the production and quality domain in our lakehouse: know which tables and fields hold what, where each comes from, and who owns it at source — and keep that knowledge documented rather than in your head.
- Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for production and quality: specify the tables, fields, and business rules the business needs, and validate the result against what actually happens on the shopfloor before anyone relies on it.
- Set and monitor data quality checks for your domain, and route each issue to the right owner — the person entering the data, the system configuration, or the pipeline — until it is fixed.
- Maintain and continuously improve Power BI dashboards tracking production and quality performance across all three plants, built on certified lakehouse data rather than side spreadsheets.
- Describe production and quality data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first.
- Automate what is manual today: recurring reports, data collection, and the preparation behind daily and weekly performance routines.
- Support the standardisation of ways of working across the three plants, partnering with our Lean Operations Specialist so that measurement and improvement pull in the same direction.
Requirements 

What You’ll Need 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Quality Management, or a related field.
- Experience in a production or quality environment; aerospace or another regulated industry is highly preferred.
- Solid understanding of manufacturing and quality metrics — throughput, cycle time, OEE, scrap and rework, first-pass yield — and of quality processes such as non-conformance handling, customer complaints and field returns, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
- Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills.
- Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back.
- Able to explain data to non-technical colleagues and business needs to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition.
- Knowledge of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, and familiarity with shopfloor or MES systems.
- A track record of improving or automating a process, not only reporting on it. Exposure to continuous improvement methods is a plus.
- Comfortable working across multiple sites and collaborating with production teams, quality engineers, and leadership alike.
- Fluent in English; Spanish, German or Dutch is a strong plus given our plant locations.
- Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred.

Who You Are 

You are equally comfortable on a shopfloor and in a data model, and you speak both languages — the plant's and the lakehouse's. You know that the fastest way to fix a reporting problem is often to walk to the place where the data is created and ask how it gets entered — and then change it.

You are structured and persistent, because aligning three plants on one way of working takes more than a good spreadsheet; it takes patience and conversations. You enjoy the detail of a root cause but stay focused on whether performance actually improved, and when something is manual or repetitive you would rather automate it than live with it.

You turn numbers into stories, stories into priorities, and priorities into measurable change. Above all, you take ownership, challenge assumptions, and stay committed to operational excellence.

title: Campaign Analyst
description:
Onze missie is helder: beter eten voor meer mensen bereikbaar maken. Als Campaign Analyst in het Customer Retention team speel je hierin een cruciale rol door onze klanten beter vast te houden. Jij zorgt ervoor dat we al onze verhalen, over al onze producten, op de juiste manier aan de juiste klant vertellen. Je bent continu, datagedreven op zoek naar verbetering; zodat we het volgende verhaal nóg beter vertellen.

Wat je gaat doen

Onze retentiestrategie wordt steeds geavanceerder. We sturen niet simpelweg 'een korting' naar alle klanten maar werken met gelaagde acties, inspirerende verhalen en gepersonaliseerde extra’s.

Enerzijds ben jij de analytische drijfkracht achter de executie van onze campagnes. Je bouwt, beheert en verbetert de analytische tooling en dashboards zodat we kunnen blijven leren. Daarmee creëer je begrip van - en grip op - de commerciële impact van campagnes, en alle onderliggende onderdelen (zoals kanaalstrategie, product-samenstelling of klantdoelgroep). Vervolgens vertaal je de verworven inzichten effectief naar succesfactoren, verbeteringstrajecten en/of toekomstige experimenten. Anderzijds werk je inhoudelijk mee. Je bepaalt samen met de Campaign Specialist welk aanbod naar welke klanten gaat, via welk kanaal en met welke verwachting en zet je ook (nieuwe) acties zelf op.

Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden: 

- Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de performance van campagnes. Je analyseert de impact, en je gebruikt inzichten om toekomstige campagnes te verbeteren, zodat we kunnen blijven innoveren in onze retentiestrategie.

- Je werkt actief mee met het team: je levert niet alleen de inzichten, maar bent ook zelf verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van campagnes.

- Je bepaalt en draait de experimentagenda: welke hypotheses testen we over aanbod, doelgroep en kanaal, en wat leren we ervan?

- Je bouwt, onderhoudt en verbetert zelf de datamodellen (SQL/dbt) en dashboards (Data Studio) waarop het team stuurt.

Dit ben jij

- Je hebt een afgeronde WO of HBO-opleiding op zak.

- Je hebt 2-5 jaar ervaring met marketing (intelligence) en data/business analytics.

- Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

- Je bent analytisch sterk en je werkt datagedreven en gestructureerd. Je kunt vloeiend SQL, hebt ervaring met het maken van dashboards en datamodellen en je gebruikt graag AI-tools om je werk efficiënter te maken. Ervaring met dbt is een pré.

- Je hebt ervaring met A/B-tests, holdout-tests en hypothese gedreven werken.

- Je hebt commercieel gevoel: je denkt net zo graag mee over het aanbod als over de cijfers erachter.

- Je bent een sterke sparringpartner: je daagt collega’s uit met data en laat je zelf ook uitdagen.

- Je bent kritisch, hands-on en niet bang om de status quo uit te dagen.

Wat wij bieden

- Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

- 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

- Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

- Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

- Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

- Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

- Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

- Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

- Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

- En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.

Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
At Deeploy, we help organisations roll out AI they can trust. Banks, insurers and pharma companies have to show they control their AI use, and most don’t yet have the tooling to do so. Deeploy gives them that control. We work with dozens of enterprise customers in finance, insurance and healthcare.

You’ll own deals from first outreach to signed contract, with a focus on the Netherlands and Northwest Europe. Most of our buyers have never bought AI governance before, so much of the work is helping them define the problem and build the internal case. You report to the COO, and the founders stay involved in deals.

What you’ll do 

- Deals: run enterprise deals from qualification to close. Deals typically take 6 to 12 months and involve risk, compliance, legal, IT and a business sponsor. The GRC (governance, risk and compliance) function is often the way in.

- Pipeline: build a large part of your own pipeline through outbound, your network, our partners and events. Marketing runs campaigns with you.

- Visibility: speak at events and roundtables for risk, compliance and AI governance audiences.

- Feedback: bring back what buyers respond to, how they compare us with alternatives, and what they miss in the product.

- Process: help set up how we qualify, forecast and run deals, and later how we onboard new sellers. We’re a small team that works with AI daily, so you’ll also build some of your own tools and agents.

After 12 months 

- You’ve closed at least 4 new enterprise accounts and built €1m+ of qualified pipeline.

- AI Governance officers know Deeploy, and know you.

- You have proven to yourself as part of our team, culture and processes.

Who we’re looking for 

- You’ve closed complex enterprise deals with long cycles and several stakeholders, ideally in financial services, insurance, pharma or life sciences.

- You know how risk, compliance or IT buyers think, from selling GRC, security, data or AI software, or from working on the buyer side.

- You have a network among these buyers in the Netherlands or elsewhere in Northwest Europe.

- You can discuss the EU AI Act and how AI systems are built and monitored with some confidence. You don’t need to be an engineer.

- You’ve worked at an early-stage company or founded one, and you’re comfortable building pipeline from scratch.

- Fluent English. Dutch or German is a strong plus.

What the role is, and what it is not 

It is a builder role. Deal ownership comes first, commercial process a close second.

It is not a lead-execution seat, and you don’t carry the number alone. The founders stay close to deals and are responsible for the commercial function.

What we offer 

- Competitive base and bonus

- Share plan from day 1

- Pension plan and other benefits

- Hybrid working from The Stack in Amsterdam, home to around 40 AI startups

- The chance to be part of an early stage startup, building the sales function and grow with it

Hiring process 

- Application: your CV or LinkedIn, and something you’ve worked on that you’re proud of

- Introductory call (30 minutes)

- Conversation with two people you’d work with closely (60 minutes)

- Case study (3 hours, timeboxed), presented to two team members

title: Model-Based Systems Engineer
description:
About Us 

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 

Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs.

What are you going to do? 

- Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack.

- Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

- Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics.

- Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow.

- Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests.

- Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test.

- Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations.

- Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work.

Qualifications 

Core Requirements: 

- BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field.

- 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones.

- Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces.

- Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent.

- Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs.

- A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems.

- Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one.

Bonus Points 

- Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware.

- Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries.

- Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption.

- Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288.

description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. 

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. 

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. 

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. 

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Patient Recruitment 

As Director of Pharma Partnerships, you will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth through partnerships with Biopharmaceutical Companies related to myTomorrows' Patient Recruitment products and services for clinical trials. You will be responsible for generating leads and establishing partnerships and alliances that support our business objectives and enhance our clinical trial portfolio.

You will develop and own strategic collaborations with BioPharma companies, from emerging innovators to global leaders, driving measurable revenue growth through our Patient Recruitment solutions and expanding our market footprint. Success in this role requires a sharp commercial mindset and proven expertise in networking, lead generation, proposal and budget development, strategic partnership development, and closing high value deals.

You will be directly accountable for delivering revenue targets through strategic deals and long-term partnerships, effectively managing opportunities from lead generation through contract award, with a clear focus on pipeline conversion, deal velocity and high win rates.

Additionally, you must continually stay informed about our capabilities, as well as industry trends, market developments, and competitor activities. This, collaborating closely with our operations team, marketing team, revenue operations team and as part of the Clinical Trials Business Unit.

Geographic Requirement: This role is open to candidates in The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada and USA. For candidates in North America , to ensure seamless collaboration with our teams, applicants must reside within the EST or CST time zones .

What you'll do in this role: 

- Continuously network and generate a high number of leads, supported by a BDR

- Develop and execute a partnership strategy focused on acquiring new partners and expanding existing relationships within the pharmaceutical industry

- Own and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets by driving pipeline conversion, accelerating deal velocity, and meeting or surpassing partnership targets and sales quotas.

- Qualify deals, negotiate agreements, and close deals that align with company objectives.

- Manage the end-to-end proposal process from opportunity qualification through contract award, including scope definition and budget development, ensuring submissions are competitive, accurate, and aligned with client needs.

- Serve as a primary presenter during capabilities presentations, bid defenses and commercial discussions, effectively articulating myTomorrows' value proposition, Patient Recruitment expertise, and differentiated solutions.

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful and seamless implementation and delivery of partnership commitments.

- Track and manage pipeline activities in HubSpot, ensuring accurate reporting and forecasting.

- 8+ years of experience in partnership development, business development, or sales roles, with a strong focus on contracting and closing deals within the pharmaceutical industry

- An existing network within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably within clinical development, clinical operations, and pre-approval access space.

- Consistent and proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and closing high-value deals.

- Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills in English.

title: Branch Support Manager - Europe
description:
About Rain for Rent International

Rain for Rent International provides innovative tank systems for liquid management applications. As an internationally operating rental and service company, expertise centers on rental, logistics, and services around the tank, focusing on the core competencies of renting storage tanks, containment systems, pumps, and filtration units.

Your role

We are looking for a hands-on Branch Support Manager ( m/f/d ) to help our teams across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France get the best from our business systems, processes and support functions.

This is not a traditional IT Manager position.

It is a highly business-facing role combining business systems, operational processes, user support, training, continuous improvement and team leadership . You will work closely with our branches and Shared Services teams to understand how people work, where they encounter challenges and how technology and better processes can make their jobs easier and our business more effective.

What you will do 

Become a Business Systems Expert 

You will develop strong expertise in the applications supporting our European operations and become a trusted point of contact for our business users.

A major focus will be our ERP environment, supporting processes such as:

- Purchasing and purchase orders

- Goods and invoice receipt

- Rental contracts

- Equipment on-hire and off-hire

- Recurring and final billing

- Credit notes and ad-hoc invoicing

- Customer, supplier and item master data

You will also support the effective use of CRM, Microsoft 365 and other operational applications.

Experience with inspHire, Zoho or Twinfield would be advantageous, but previous knowledge of our specific applications is not essential if you have strong ERP/business systems experience and learn quickly.

Help People Get the Best From Technology 

You will work directly with colleagues across our branches to understand challenges, answer questions and identify better ways of working.

That includes:

- Providing practical systems and process support

- Training new and existing users

- Developing SOPs, quick-reference guides and training materials

- Creating screen recordings and short training videos

- Building a structured, version-controlled knowledge library

- Identifying recurring problems and addressing their root causes

Most importantly, you will explain the why , not only the how .

Connect Systems With Business Reality 

Good systems only create good information when they are used correctly.

You will therefore work closely with Operations, Sales, Finance, Fleet and other Shared Services functions to improve the quality and consistency of the processes behind our data.

You will help us ensure that operational information, CRM pipelines, rental transactions, margins and management KPIs accurately reflect what is happening in the business.

Listen, Challenge and Improve 

Our branches know their business and will bring you ideas and requirements.

Your job is not simply to say yes.

You will listen, understand the underlying need and assess whether the best answer is a change to a system, process, training or something else.

For larger initiatives, you will help structure requirements, assess benefits, costs, effort and risks, and make clear recommendations to leadership.

Lead a Small Team 

You will lead a developing Branch Support function, expected to include approximately three team members across business support and IT/helpdesk activities .

This remains a hands-on role. You will lead the team while actively participating in support, training, problem solving and improvement initiatives yourself.

Stay Curious 

Technology is changing quickly and we want to take advantage of it.

You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious about tools such as Microsoft Copilot , automation and new ways technology can help colleagues work more effectively.

The Person We Are Looking For 

Systems knowledge matters, but how you work with people matters just as much.

You are someone who:

- Listens before proposing a solution

- Is patient and enjoys explaining things

- Can train and support colleagues with different levels of systems experience

- Builds credibility and strong working relationships

- Can persuade and influence without relying on hierarchy

- Is comfortable constructively challenging a request

- Is pragmatic and realistic about priorities, resources and costs

- Learns new business processes quickly

- Enjoys solving problems

- Is comfortable being visible and close to the operational business

- Is curious about technology and AI

You should be equally comfortable discussing a process with a branch administrator, working through a systems problem with IT, understanding a commercial requirement from Sales or presenting a recommendation to leadership.

European Scope 

The role supports operations across Germany, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands and France .

Regular interaction with the branches is a fundamental part of the position. You should therefore be willing to travel across our European locations , build strong relationships with local teams and spend time understanding how our operations work in practice.

Regular office presence is also expected, currently anticipated at up to three days per week at our office in Potsdam.

Why This Role? 

This is an opportunity to shape a developing European support function rather than simply inherit an established helpdesk.

You will have the opportunity to influence:

- How we use our business systems

- How we support and train users

- How processes are standardised across countries

- How knowledge is documented and shared

- How new technology and AI are adopted

- How Branch Support develops as our European organisation evolves

If you enjoy bringing together people, processes and technology and want a role where you can see the practical impact of your work across the business, we would like to hear from you.

Rain for Rent International is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive working environment and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, age, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS 

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

- Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS 

- Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible 

- Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably 

- Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms 

- Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability 

- Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls 

- Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives 

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED 

- 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments 

- Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting 

- Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments 

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflows Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainability Experience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutions Deep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. 

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional: 

- Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure

- Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.

- Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services

- Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) 

- Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) 

- Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE 

- In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.

- In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT? 

- We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.

- We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 

- We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.

- Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness. 

- We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

title: AI/ML Researcher
description:
Über YLAB

Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden.

Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene.

Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten.

Warum YLAB

Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard.

Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt.

Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt.

Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch.

Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden.

Was wir bieten

- Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht.

- Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst.

- Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt.

- Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln.

Über die Rolle

Wie versteht ein Sprachmodell eine Vierjährige? Und wie erklärt es ihr die Welt, ohne sie zu überfordern? Dazu gibt es kaum Paper und keine Benchmarks. Genau da setzt du an.

Du bist unsere erste dedizierte Research-Stelle. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von KI, Sprache und Pädagogik, mit echten Familien statt Laborbedingungen und mit direktem Draht ins Produkt.

Was dich erwartet: offene Fragen mit Substanz, ein Fachbeirat aus Bildung und Psychologie und die Freiheit, Studien so zu bauen, wie sie sein müssen.

Wie du uns helfen kannst

- Du entwirfst und machst Studien mit Kindern und Familien. Von der Beobachtung im Wohnzimmer bis zum strukturierten Test.

- Du baust Methoden, um altersgerechte Antworten zu bewerten: Was heißt verständlich, was heißt zu viel?

- Du übersetzt Erkenntnisse in Modell- und Produktentscheidungen, zusammen mit Engineering und Pädagogik.

- Du behältst die Forschung im Blick (Child-Computer Interaction, Speech, LLM-Evals) und holst rein, was uns weiterbringt.

- Du teilst, was wir lernen. Wir forschen nicht für die Schublade.

Melde dich, wenn:

- Du hast einen Research-Hintergrund, etwa HCI, Psychologie, Linguistik oder ML.

- Du hast schon mit Nutzer:innen geforscht, am besten mit Kindern.

- Du kannst beides: Interviews auswerten und saubere Metriken bauen.

- Du schreibst klar. Für Paper genauso wie für Produktentscheidungen.

- Du magst es, wenn deine Forschung nächste Woche im Prototyp steckt.

Eher nicht, wenn: du Forschung als Selbstzweck siehst oder zwei Jahre Vorlauf brauchst, bevor etwas testbar ist.

Onoo hört zu, denkt mit und antwortet kindgerecht. Dahinter stecken Spracherkennung, ein kuratierter Wissensraum und eine mehrstufige Safety-Pipeline. Der Prototyp funktioniert, der Launch ist 2027. Jetzt bauen wir die Pipeline, die Millionen Kinderfragen aushält.

title: Founder Associate
description:
Über YLAB

Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden.

Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene.

Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten.

Warum YLAB

Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard.

Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt.

Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt.

Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch.

Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden.

Was wir bieten

- Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht.

- Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst.

- Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt.

- Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln.

Über die Rolle

Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern, näher dran geht nicht. Founder Associate heißt bei uns: Du bist die Feuerwehr. Wo es brennt, bist du zuerst da, egal ob Investor-Update, Prototypen-Logistik oder der Messestand am Freitag.

Dafür bekommst du den ehrlichsten Crashkurs in Company Building, den wir kennen: Du sitzt in den Entscheidungen, nicht im CC. Was du hier in einem Jahr siehst, sehen andere in fünf.

Geht in Vollzeit oder als Werkstudent:in. Uns ist egal, was auf deinem Vertrag steht, solange du Verantwortung willst.

Wie du uns helfen kannst

- Du räumst weg, was die Gründer bremst: Recherchen, Entscheidungsvorlagen, Angebote, Ämterpost, Orga.

- Du springst dahin, wo es gerade brennt, von Operations über Events bis zum Support für unsere Testfamilien.

- Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor: Zahlen ziehen, Optionen sortieren, klare Empfehlung dazuschreiben.

- Du baust kleine Prozesse und Tools, damit dasselbe Feuer nicht zweimal ausbricht.

- Du hältst die Fäden zu Partnern und Lieferanten zusammen, wenn es schnell gehen muss.

Melde dich, wenn:

- Du willst in einem Jahr mehr lernen als andere in fünf.

- Du erledigst Dinge, bevor jemand fragt, ob sie schon erledigt sind.

- Chaos macht dich nicht nervös. Du machst Listen draus.

- Du schreibst klar und schnell, auf Deutsch und auf Englisch.

- Du bist Generalist:in aus Überzeugung und lernst Neues schneller, als Stellenprofile es erlauben.

- Du studierst noch oder bist gerade fertig? Passt. Erfahrung schlägt Etikett.

Eher nicht, wenn: du eine Jobbeschreibung brauchst, die stimmt. Deine ändert sich hier jede Woche. Oder wenn du Feuer lieber meldest, als es zu löschen.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Buyer
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Buyer Domain at Vinted is dedicated to creating a seamless and highly engaging experience for our members as they search, discover, and purchase items. Our challenge is unique: unlike standard e-commerce, our peer-to-peer catalogue consists of hundreds of millions of entirely unique, single-inventory listings, with millions of new items uploaded daily. Connecting the right buyer with the perfect item in real-time is at the very core of Vinted's success.

The CVP team owns the core platform and services that govern how content is geofenced, balanced, and surfaced across Vinted's growing international network of markets. We build robust systems and tooling that manage cross-border visibility, enabling smooth and gradual market connections (e.g., FR-DE, BE-FR-ES) while optimising key liquidity metrics like Sell-Through Rate (STR%) and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) by balancing the content in multiple channels.

Our team works closely with Content Visibility Management, Search, and Recommender relevance teams to accelerate product development. Currently, we are driving the automation of content visibility experimentation & analysis. Rather than having different content channels independently re-implement visibility controls, we are building a unified platform to provide autonomy to Decision Scientists. In addition, we are highly contributing in growing new large markets such as the USA and Australia.

In this position, you’ll 

- Drive technical execution: Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable, reliable, and secure backend systems to ensure efficient content visibility and search mechanisms.

- Guide technical decisions: Contribute to and challenge the technical direction of our backend services, leading system design reviews and ensuring high-quality, maintainable code.

- Scale features globally: Implement and shape A/B tested features that positively impact our 80+ million users. Code changes are rolled out instantly to production.

- Own your services: Monitor and improve backend service performance and stability. The team owns and monitors service-layer measurements (SLIs, SLOs, etc.) and has an on-call rotation which you will participate in.

- Lead team-level initiatives: Lead and drive technical initiatives within the team, while collaborating on domain-wide integrations with other engineering teams (such as Search and Recommender relevance teams).

- Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with engineering and product managers, analysts, and other stakeholders, facilitating clear communication within the team and across domains.

- Contribute to product direction: Provide technical feasibility assessments, identify technical risks, and provide effort estimations to help shape our team's product roadmap.

- Foster engineering excellence: Mentor, guide, and share knowledge with other engineers in the team to support their technical growth and promote collaborative best practices

About you 

- You have extensive experience in backend software engineering, with a proven track record of designing and building scalable, distributed, and highly available systems.

- You are highly proficient in backend development. We primarily use Go, Kotlin, Ruby, Python — while prior experience in these specific languages is beneficial, a strong foundation in modern backend engineering and a willingness to learn is what matters most.

- Experience with event streaming platforms like Kafka, Apache Flink, or others for real-time data processing and message queueing.

- A track record working with search engines, information retrieval and ranking optimisations technologies (e.g., Vespa, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch) is a high advantage. If not, we expect you to have a strong willingness and motivation to learn.

- You are enthusiastic about AI technologies, use AI tools daily in your work, and proactively learn and experiment with how to adopt AI to boost engineering outcomes.

- Strong understanding of continuous integration and deployment pipelines, with experience in tools like Jenkins for automating builds and deployments.

- Experience with observability and monitoring tools (we use Grafana, Kibana, and others) to keep services healthy and define SLIs/SLOs.

- Experience working with relational and in-memory databases.

- Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working with cross-functional peers (Product, Analytics, SRE).

- Experience in mentoring other engineers, providing constructive feedback, and promoting engineering best practices within your team.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

Work perks 

- The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

- 30 days of paid annual leave

- Newest MacBook models

- Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

- Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

- Lunch benefit per your workday

- Frequent team-building events

- A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

- Access to a discounted gym membership plan

- Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution

- Supplemental Private Health Insurance

- Life and Disability insurance

- A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport

- A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget 

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity 

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

Die jährliche Bruttogehaltsspanne für diese Position beträgt:

€87.600 — €118.500 EUR

title: Territory Account Executive - Germany
description:
About Team & About Role 

Rubrik helps organisations in every major industry stay resilient against cyberattacks, insider threats and operational disruption, protecting the data that hospitals, banks and public institutions depend on every day. As Territory Account Executive in Southern Germany, you’ll build business in one of Europe’s strongest industrial and financial regions, with large companies and ambitious Mittelstand firms on your doorstep. You’ll join a close-knit German team that shares deal strategy openly, backed by regional marketing, events and partner support to help you open doors.

What You’ll Do 

- Own a territory of accounts, from established Mittelstand to larger companies, and decide where your time creates the most value.

- Tier your list and create the entry points that turn them into real opportunities.

- Generate your own pipeline through outbound, LinkedIn, local events and partners, so that first conversations become qualified deals that protect customers against cyber risk.

- Make the most of Rubrik’s regional marketing, events and partner activity by following up quickly on the interest it creates in your territory.

- Run multi-stakeholder sales cycles end to end with MEDDPICC: find the budget owner, build champions and position Rubrik against the full scope of customer risk.

- Work with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development and partners to extend your reach, and meet customers in person to build lasting relationships.

- Learn from experienced colleagues through structured enablement and hands-on mentoring, and share what works with the German team in pipeline reviews and deal strategy sessions.

- Feed local market insight and competitive signals back to Rubrik’s leadership to shape how we go to market in Germany.

Experience You’ll Need 

- A track record of winning new business in B2B enterprise software or SaaS, with consistent quota attainment and self-generated pipeline.

- Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and engaging technical, security and executive buyers.

- Fluent German and professional English.

- A structured approach to qualification and pipeline management, with MEDDPICC or a comparable framework.

- Based in or near Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, Stuttgart or Munich, with willingness to travel regularly across your territory.

- A learning mindset: you seek feedback, adapt quickly and want to keep growing with the support of a hands-on manager.

Preferred Qualifications 

- Background in cybersecurity, data protection, backup/recovery or adjacent infrastructure and cloud categories. It’s not a must, since we’ll teach you the rest.

- Experience selling with channel partners.

- Knowledge of the industrial, financial and Mittelstand landscape in Western and Southern Germany.

- Familiarity with Salesforce for pipeline management and forecasting.

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About Sezzle: 

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation :

For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is $12,500 - $20,800 USD based on location and experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role: 

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, operate, and scale the platform that powers Sezzle. Your focus will be the hardest infrastructure problems: increasing throughput, reducing latency, removing capacity bottlenecks, strengthening resilience, and making production operations more automated and predictable as the business grows.

You will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. Your impact will come from the systems you build, the problems you solve, and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Our stack runs on AWS , with workloads orchestrated on Kubernetes and data anchored in Aurora RDS (MySQL and Postgres) . You should know these technologies deeply and be comfortable moving between cloud architecture, networking, cluster internals, database performance, and application behavior to understand how the entire system scales. You will write code and infrastructure-as-code, debug production systems, and deliver changes that hold up under real traffic and failure conditions.

Operational ownership is part of the job. You will participate in the on-call rotation and take a hands-on role in recovering from major incidents, including full outages. We need someone who can form and test hypotheses using logs, metrics, and traces, make sound mitigation decisions with incomplete information, and turn incident findings into lasting engineering fixes.

You will also build and apply AI-assisted infrastructure and SRE tooling for incident investigation, capacity analysis, runbook automation, and toil reduction. You will evaluate these tools through practical results and apply appropriate access controls, validation, and auditability to their use in production.

This role reports to engineering leadership and works closely with application engineers, Security, and Compliance. You will develop a deep understanding of how Sezzle's business operates and how customer journeys, transaction patterns, and product decisions shape infrastructure demand and behavior. You will use that understanding to identify and deliver improvements across teams and technical domains, connecting infrastructure decisions to better customer outcomes and business performance.

What you’ll do: 

- Own the technical architecture and evolution of core infrastructure : identify system limits, prioritize technical improvements, and implement changes that support increasing traffic, data volume, and workload complexity.

- Connect business understanding to improvements across the system : learn how key business workflows behave in production, trace their impact across applications, data, and infrastructure, and partner across teams to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency beyond any single service or team's scope.

- Engineer for scale and performance : build capacity models, run load and stress tests, diagnose bottlenecks across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and databases, and validate improvements against throughput, latency, saturation, and cost per workload.

- Design and build AWS infrastructure : implement resilient account, IAM, network, and service architectures; address service quotas, fault isolation, and multi-AZ or multi-region requirements as workloads grow.

- Build and operate the Kubernetes platform : improve cluster architecture, lifecycle automation, workload isolation, resource allocation, autoscaling, safe upgrades, and deployment reliability.

- Scale and optimize Aurora RDS for MySQL and Postgres : tune queries and indexes, address connection and replication bottlenecks, plan capacity, improve failover behavior, and implement safe schema changes and database migrations with application engineers.

- Improve reliability through engineering : define and instrument service-level objectives and error budgets with service owners; implement failure isolation, backpressure, load shedding, and safe retry behavior where needed to prevent cascading failures.

- Participate in on-call and drive technical recovery during serious incidents : use evidence-based triage, execute mitigations, communicate findings, and implement corrective actions from postmortems.

- Implement and test disaster recovery : design backup, restore, and failover mechanisms against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives; run recovery exercises and document measured results.

- Build infrastructure-as-code and operational automation : make provisioning, configuration, deployments, upgrades, and recovery reproducible, reviewed, testable, and recoverable. Eliminate recurring manual work through code.

- Build observability that makes production diagnosable : improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with visibility into service health, scaling limits, and customer impact.

- Deliver safe infrastructure migrations : design phased rollouts, compatibility checks, validation, and rollback paths for changes to shared production systems.

- Improve cloud cost efficiency through technical changes : right-size resources, improve utilization, tune autoscaling and storage, and quantify savings while maintaining reliability and performance targets.

- Build and evaluate AI-assisted operational tooling : apply AI to investigation, runbooks, anomaly analysis, and repetitive operations, with bounded permissions, reviewable actions, and measurable improvements in accuracy or toil.

- Make technical decisions clear and executable : write architecture proposals, evaluate technology tradeoffs through prototypes and benchmarks, review changes affecting shared infrastructure, and document how systems operate and fail.

What We look for: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required)

- 12+ years of experience across infrastructure, platform, site reliability, software development, or related engineering disciplines, with substantial hands-on depth designing and operating production infrastructure at scale.

- Deep expertise with AWS : production experience across compute, IAM, multi-account architectures, and networking, including VPC design and private connectivity.

- Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production : cluster lifecycle, scheduling, resource management, autoscaling, networking, and troubleshooting business-critical workloads. EKS experience is strongly preferred.

- Deep expertise with relational databases at scale , specifically RDS/Aurora (MySQL and/or Postgres) : query performance, indexing, connection management, replication, high availability, failover, and verified backup and recovery.

- A track record of personally delivering infrastructure scaling improvements : identifying constraints, measuring baseline behavior, implementing changes, and demonstrating gains in capacity, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency.

- Strong coding and automation skills , using Golang, Python, or similar languages to build production tooling and eliminate operational toil, alongside infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or equivalent.

- Strong systems fundamentals : Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, storage, concurrency, and distributed system failure modes, with the ability to debug problems across infrastructure and application boundaries.

- Experience operating a 24/7, high-availability platform where downtime has direct customer or revenue impact, including hands-on incident response and postmortem remediation.

- Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and demonstrated ability to recover production systems under pressure using evidence-based triage, safe mitigation, and clear technical communication.

- Experience implementing and testing disaster recovery against defined recovery objectives, including restoring data and validating service recovery.

- Practical experience with observability, load testing, capacity planning, and safe CI/CD practices for shared production infrastructure.

- Active use of AI tooling in engineering or operations , with practical judgment about its limitations and how to verify generated code, recommendations, and operational actions.

- Ability to carry ambiguous technical problems from investigation through production delivery and collaborate across engineering disciplines to resolve system-wide constraints.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills: 

- Experience in fintech, payments, or banking , operating infrastructure with demanding reliability, security, and audit requirements.

- Experience with multi-region architectures, chaos engineering, and failure testing , including the consistency and recovery tradeoffs of distributed data systems.

- Proficiency with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo , or comparable observability systems.

- Experience building internal platform capabilities and self-service tooling , including deployment automation, progressive delivery, and reusable infrastructure components.

- Experience building AI-assisted incident investigation or operational automation with restricted access, auditable execution, and clear human review points

- 

About You: 

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

- You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

- You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

- You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

- You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

- You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

- You go deep : you investigate how systems behave under load and failure, follow the evidence, and fix underlying causes.

- You build and ship : you turn architecture into working code, tested infrastructure, and safe production changes.

- You measure results : you can explain the impact of your work in availability, latency, capacity, recovery time, cost, or hours of toil

title: Praktikum AI & Automation – Virtual Power Plant (m/w/d)
description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Omniwatt Energy ist die Strom-Unit von Enpal und macht saubere Energie für jeden Haushalt zugänglich – vom günstigsten Stromtarif Deutschlands bis hin zu intelligenten Energielösungen, die Erzeugung, Speicherung und Verbrauch optimal vernetzen.

Mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen und einem schnell wachsenden Kundenstamm bauen wir ein Team, das den deutschen Energiemarkt aktiv mitgestaltet. Dabei verbinden wir Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Skalierung eines Marktführers – über alle Bereiche hinweg, von Operations und Technologie über Finance und Customer Support bis hin zu Produktentwicklung.

Deine Aufgaben 

Als Praktikant:in im Tech Venture Development bei Enpal Energy arbeitest du an einer zentralen Frage: Wie können wir unser Geschäft mit smarter Technologie skalieren? Im Mittelpunkt steht unser Virtual Power Plant. Wir vernetzen Haushalte mit ihren Solaranlagen, Speichern und Wärmepumpen zu einem intelligenten Kraftwerk und handeln ihren Strom smart am Energiemarkt. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Ops und Tech. Dabei bringst du AI-Lösungen, die unser virtuelles Kraftwerk skalierbar machen, vom Prototyp in den echten Betrieb.

- Eigene Projekte: Du übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für eigene Projekte, von der Problemanalyse über die Lösungsfindung bis zum Go-live.

- AI Agents & Automatisierung: Du übersetzt Business Needs in konkrete Lösungen. Du baust Agents, Workflows und Automatisierungen mit No-Code-, Low-Code- und AI-Tools und bringst sie in den Betrieb.

- Impact messbar machen: Du bereitest Daten auf, baust Dashboards und lieferst damit die Grundlage für Entscheidungen.

- Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammen, unter anderem Ops und Tech, und treibst Initiativen über Teamgrenzen hinweg voran.

Dein Profil 

- Du studierst an der Schnittstelle von Business und Tech, z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder hast in Studium und Praktika beide Welten kennengelernt.

- Du hast mindestens ein relevantes Praktikum abgeschlossen, z. B. in einem Start-up, in der Beratung oder im Venture Building.

- Du arbeitest gern mit Tools wie Claude, Cursor, Airtable, Make, n8n, Power BI, Snowflake oder SQL oder arbeitest dich schnell in neue Technologien ein.

- Du denkst analytisch und findest pragmatische Lösungen, die auf Fakten beruhen.

- Du übernimmst Ownership und wartest nicht auf perfekte Rahmenbedingungen.

- Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

- Du bist mindestens 4 Monate verfügbar.

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen 

- Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

- Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

- Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

- Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

- Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.
