title: Manager, Media Planning & Strategy
description:
WHY DEPT® ?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT® , you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

We believe that real media impact comes from having a holistic understanding of consumers, culture, channels, content and commerce. Deciphering present day trends and historical performance from these interconnected and interdependent fields begins to represent our journey towards lasting growth for our clients. 

As such, we are looking for a Senior Manager, Integrated Media Strategy & Planning who shares this approach and wants to join a talented team of growth marketers. This role is equal parts research and insight development as well as a strategic client partner. This person will join us as a key member of our strategy team; working alongside the directors to provide robust data-based strategies to our clients while also helping to guide larger cross-functional teams on campaign planning and ongoing optimizations. 

In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor for internal cross-functional team members and external partners and become a steward of integrated planning and strategy core practices and solutions, with a particular focus on transforming the way consumers engage and shop across retail marketplaces and direct-to-consumer (D2C) environments. 

DEPT is a remote-first organization. For this role, we’re looking for someone located in the Pacific or Mountain time zone to align with team and client schedules. 

You'll be responsible for:

Planning 

- Developing integrated media plans across D2C and retail marketplace business models, including tactic-level plans and investment scenarios, grounded in strategy, methodology benchmarks, and thoughtful assumptions.

- Translating research insights into actionable media plans by synthesizing inputs from tools such as GWI, eMarketer, Pathmatics, Similarweb, and client or platform data (Meta, Google, Amazon, The Trade Desk, etc.).

- Building full-funnel, channel-agnostic media plans using both CPC- and CPM-based investment frameworks. 

- Developing audience-first communication plans, including budget allocation, KPI frameworks, channel selection, and partner recommendations.

- Aligning campaign planning with product launch calendars, retail media opportunities, and promotional moments across key U.S. retailers.

- Applying a strong working knowledge of Amazon Ads (search, DSP, display) to support retail and performance-focused planning efforts. Familiarity with Best Buy Ads, Walmart Connect, and Target Roundel is highly valuable, with the ability to adapt plans to evolving retail media capabilities and brand footprints.

- Maintaining awareness of global retail and go-to-market considerations to inform planning for international expansion and multi-market execution.

Collaboration 

- Serving as a dependable thought partner to strategy leads, helping to operationalize strategic planning frameworks and guide planning through to activation.

- Working closely with cross-functional team members both externally and internally across Client Services, Media Activation, Data Science, and Creative to deliver connected plans and ensure seamless campaign execution, including tracking plan vs. actuals.

- Navigating complexity across platforms, stakeholders, and business models, and translating that complexity into clear, actionable plans.

- Presenting and articulating planning recommendations clearly to both internal and external stakeholders with confidence.

- Boosting morale and contributing to an inclusive, supportive team culture by being a positive example in group problem solving and growing careers of junior team members.

- Sharing platform trends, retail innovations, and media shifts with the team to inspire fresh thinking and continuous improvement.

You'll need to have:

- 4+ years of hands-on experience in media planning and strategy, with an emphasis on digital media buying both on and off retail environments.

- 2+ years experience using planning and research tools such as GWI, Pathmatics, Comscore, eMarketer, and platform-native dashboards.

- 2+ years of client facing and team management experience.

- Strong familiarity with Amazon’s retail media solutions; knowledge of Best Buy, Target, Walmart, and other retail platforms is a strong plus.

- Proven experience planning across both CPC and CPM channels, with a clear understanding of brand and performance media and how they work together.

- Strong understanding of audience segmentation, full-funnel planning, and measurement frameworks.

- Ability to clearly and concisely articulate a persuasive point of view, both written and verbal, presenting to project stakeholders.

- A curious and creative mindset, while also rigorous and analytical.

- Energized by the evolving intersection of media, retail, technology, and consumer behavior.

- Strong collaboration, client relationship building, and leadership skills.

- Experience navigating cross-functional teams and dynamic organizational environments.

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU: 

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle, or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step. 

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S. 

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place. 

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT® 

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION 

At DEPT® , we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives. 

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine. 

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Palo Alto Networks is seeking an experienced, strategic, and proactive Senior Manager, Public Policy & Government Affairs responsible for Australia and New Zealand, based in Australia, preferably in Sydney or Canberra.

Policy Strategy & Advocacy: Design and execute strategic advocacy initiatives across Australia and New Zealand on issues including AI security, supply chain risk management, zero trust, incident reporting, critical infrastructure resilience, and cloud security. Engage with Australian Federal, State and Territory Governments and relevant New Zealand ministries, departments, and agencies.

Government & Parliamentary Engagement: Develop trusted relationships with ministers’ offices, senior public servants, relevant parliamentary committees, and government cybersecurity leaders in both countries. Priority stakeholders will include:

- Australia: The Department of Home Affairs, ASD/ACSC, the Department of Defence, the Department of Industry, Science and Resources, the Digital Transformation Agency, and relevant State and Territory cybersecurity and digital government bodies.

- New Zealand: GCSB/NCSC, the Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet, the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment, the Department of Internal Affairs, and relevant defence, education, health and digital government stakeholders.

Qualifications 

- 8 plus years of relevant experience in cybersecurity public policy, technology policy, or government affairs, preferably spanning government and the private technology sector.

- Experience within Australian or New Zealand government, a ministerial office, parliamentary committee, or a relevant cybersecurity, national security, or digital government agency is highly alued. Experience working across both markets is desirable.

- Subject Matter Expertise: Deep familiarity with the Australian and New Zealand cybersecurity nand technology policy landscapes, including Australia’s ASD Information Security Manual, Essential Eight, and Information Security Registered Assessors Program (IRAP), and New Zealand’s Information Security Manual and Protective Security Requirements. 

- Strong understanding of critical infrastructure security, government security and cloud assurance settings, software supply chain security, and emerging AI policy frameworks. 

- Familiarity with international cybersecurity frameworks and their relevance to both markets is also desirable.

- Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, International Affairs, Political Science, Computer Science, Law, or a related field. 

- Exceptional written, analytical, and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to synthesise complex technical security topics for non-technical policymakers, senior government officials, and C-suite executives.

- An established network of trusted relationships across Australian Federal, State and Territory Governments and relevant New Zealand government stakeholders.

- Strong relationships with the Department of Home Affairs, ASD/ACSC, GCSB/NCSC, relevant parliamentary committees, and cybersecurity, national security, and digital government agencies are particularly valuable.

- Based in Australia, with Sydney or Canberra preferred, and willing to travel regularly to Canberra, other Australian capitals, and New Zealand, particularly Wellington, for government and stakeholder engagement.

Our Commitment 

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

- Rapid Prototyping and AI-Enabled Design: Experience using interactive prototyping, iterative testing, and emerging AI-powered design tools to validate concepts quickly, resolve ambiguity, and accelerate product development.

- Close Collaboration with Engineering: Proven ability to partner with frontend engineers to evaluate technical feasibility, communicate design intent, and deliver implementation-ready specifications across modern web, desktop, and native applications.

- Familiarity with React, Electron, native application architectures, and design-to-code workflows.

- Experience leading design strategy and influencing product and engineering decisions as a senior individual contributor in a cross-functional environment.

How Success Is Measured 

- Design Delivery and Engineering Velocity: Deliver high-quality, implementation-ready designs for Avaya Infinity roadmap initiatives on schedule. Use rapid prototyping, clear specifications, and close engineering collaboration to target a 25–30% improvement in design-to-code velocity.

Reduce friction in legacy workflows while improving consistency, usability, and scalability across the platform.

title: Learning and Development Business Partner
description:
We have a fantastic opportunity for a Learning and Development Business Partner, to join our Senior Leadership Team. This role will be remote with national travel.

Reporting directly to the Group Chief People Officer you will strengthen management capability and team effectiveness across EMED Group through practical, accessible learning. Working in partnership with operational leaders and People colleagues, deliver Management Acceleration Pathway (MAP) modules, bespoke local training and Insights-based development, while expanding and maintaining the online learning library.

This hands-on national role translates business and team development needs into learning that managers can apply every day, supporting consistent management practice, operational effectiveness and patient-centred service delivery.

Benefits for the role include

- Competitive Salary

- Annual car allowance

- Performance related bonus

- Private Healthcare

- 33 days annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays) with the option to purchase additional leave through salary sacrifice.

- Life Assurance

- 24/7 online/telephone GP Consultation and access to prescriptions.

- 2nd opinion medical support following diagnosis or where a colleague is on a treatment pathway.

- Cash-plan benefits, providing colleagues the option of protecting themselves in case of illness and recuperation, including dental, optical, chiropody.

- Access to mental health and physiotherapy consultations.

- Access to legal advice on domestic issues e.g. motoring offences, wills and probate, and personal injury.

- Long Service Recognition Scheme – recognising colleagues for their continued service after 5 years and at 5-year intervals with an increase in annual leave.

Role Responsibilities

- Plan, coordinate and deliver MAP modules nationally through face-to-face workshops, virtual sessions and blended learning.

- Build managers’ practical skills in communication, coaching, constructive feedback, delegation, team development, managing change and everyday management conversations.

- Tailor examples, exercises and resources to operational settings while maintaining agreed MAP learning outcomes and delivery standards.

- Work with HR team and subject matter experts to keep management content accurate, relevant and aligned with organisational policies and priorities.

- Partner with operational leaders and HR Business Partners to understand local priorities and identify management and team development needs.

- Design and deliver bespoke workshops, team development days and targeted training, adapting relevant MAP modules to meet local needs.

- Support teams to strengthen communication, collaboration, clarity of responsibilities and shared ownership of agreed actions.

- Promote MAP, team development and online learning through clear communications that explain the benefits and encourage participation.

- Equip managers to deliver effective team briefings, listening conversations and communication during change through targeted training and practical resources.

- Coordinate and deliver Insights-based development sessions in accordance with the chosen tool’s requirements and applicable practitioner accreditation.

- Help managers and colleagues understand working preferences, adapt communication and collaborate effectively, without labelling people or making assumptions about capability.

- Support teams to agree practical actions and revisit progress after sessions.

- Maintain a prioritised development plan for new online modules, informed by management learning needs, recurring local requirements and organisational priorities.

- Design and build engaging digital modules with clear learning objectives, practical scenarios, knowledge checks and supporting resources.

- Use evaluation findings to improve programmes and inform priorities, distinguishing the contribution of learning from other factors affecting operational outcomes.

Do you have what it takes?

- Experience designing and delivering management development and team learning in a multi-site or geographically dispersed organisation.

- Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to engage different audiences through face-to-face and virtual delivery.

- Ability to identify learning needs with stakeholders and translate them into practical, proportionate development solutions.

- Experience creating digital learning modules using authoring tools and working with learning management systems.

- Understanding of adult learning, blended learning and methods for evaluating learning application.

- Clear written and verbal communication, strong stakeholder relationships and the confidence to influence without direct authority.

- Ability to manage a national delivery schedule alongside bespoke requests and content development deadlines.

- Commitment to accessible learning, confidentiality, respectful working relationships and patient-centred service delivery.

- Ability to meet the national travel requirements of the role.

Desirable experience and qualifications

- Relevant learning and development, training, coaching or organisational development qualification, or equivalent practical experience.

- Accreditation in the Insights tool used by the organisation, or willingness to complete the required accreditation before independent delivery.

- Experience supporting healthcare, patient transport, logistics or other operational, shift-based services.

- Experience linking engagement feedback with team development and management learning.

About Us

EMED Group is an established healthcare logistics provider that enables access to health and social care through our four specialist divisions. We are one of the largest health and care partners to the NHS with 4,000 colleagues across over 60 bases UK-wide.

EMED Group is committed to pro-actively improving the wellbeing of our communities by providing access to vital health and social care services across the UK.

title: Director, Talent Acquisition Strategy
description:
See your work in a new light. 

At LUX Infusion , we’re reimagining infusion care to be more human, supportive, and connected. Inspired by lux —meaning light - we guide patients, providers, and partners through complex therapies with clarity, compassion, and confidence.

As a clinician-led, U.S.-based organization, we put people first - helping patients feel seen and supported through faster therapy starts, dedicated care coordination, and meaningful collaboration. Our commitment to inclusion, diversity, equity, and advancement (IDEA) is central to our culture, ensuring every team member feels valued and empowered to make a difference.

We’re looking for a Director, Talent Acquisition Strategy who wants their work to mean something—someone who brings care, accountability, and purpose to what they do every day.

Schedule & Location

Location: Overland Park, KS, or Plantation, FL or Remote

Schedule:

- Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM 

Why This Role Matters

As a Director, Talent Acquisition Strategy, you play a critical role in ensuring patients receive safe, effective, and timely specialty infusion therapies. Your expertise helps guide medication management, support clinical decision-making, and ensure every prescription is reviewed with accuracy and care.

In this role, you’ll contribute to work that:

- Helps patients feel informed, supported, and confident throughout their treatment journey

- Ensures safe and compliant specialty pharmacy operations

- Supports clinicians, providers, and care teams through clinical expertise and collaboration

- Advances positive patient outcomes through thoughtful medication management and oversight

Everything we do connects back to real people navigating complex healthcare journeys—and this role helps make that journey brighter.

What You'll Do

The Director, Talent Acquisition Strategy leads the development and execution of LUX Infusion 's enterprise-wide talent acquisition strategy. This role is responsible for building a scalable, data-driven recruiting function that anticipates workforce needs and supports clinical, operational, professional, and leadership hiring across multiple states and markets.

The Director partners closely with executive leadership, Human Resources, Finance, Operations, and hiring leaders to translate business plans into workforce strategies; strengthen the employer brand and talent pipelines; optimize recruiting and onboarding processes; and use meaningful KPIs and analytics to improve hiring outcomes. The ideal candidate is a strategic, hands-on leader who can build systems, influence stakeholders, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, growing organization. Success in this role requires the ability to connect enterprise strategy with disciplined execution, create transparency through reliable data, and build a recruiting function that consistently delivers talent needed for growth.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Talent Acquisition Strategy and Workforce Planning 
• Develop and execute an enterprise-wide talent acquisition strategy aligned with LUX Infusion 's growth plans, operating priorities, and long-term workforce needs.
• Partner with Finance, Operations, Human Resources, and business leaders to translate growth projections, turnover trends, labor availability, and productivity expectations into short- and long-term workforce plans.
• Create hiring forecasts, capacity models, prioritization frameworks, and recruiting resource plans that improve organizational readiness and reduce reactive hiring.
• Advise executive leadership on talent availability, geographic labor-market conditions, hiring risks, recruiting investments, and workforce implications of business decisions.
• Establish consistent, equitable, and legally compliant standards for job intake, candidate evaluation, interviewing, selection, and hiring decisions nationwide.
• Support workforce planning and talent acquisition needs for acquisitions, integrations, and new-market expansion as a recurring, core component of this role, not an incidental one.

Sourcing, Pipeline Development, and Employer Brand 
• Build sustainable talent pipelines for critical, recurring, and difficult-to-fill positions across clinical, operational, professional, and leadership functions.
• Develop data-driven sourcing strategies using labor-market intelligence, geographic analysis, candidate and conversion data, referrals, professional networks, educational partnerships, and digital channels.
• Measure source quality and channel effectiveness to focus recruiting resources on approaches that produce qualified, durable hires drawn from broad candidate pools.
• Develop and maintain a compelling employer value proposition and partner with Marketing and Communications to strengthen the LUX Infusion employment brand.
• Create strategies for passive-candidate engagement, talent-community management, and market-specific outreach within a consistent national framework.

Recruiting Operations, Technology, and Onboarding 
• Evaluate and optimize the end-to-end recruiting process, including requisition approval, sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offers, pre-employment requirements, and transition to onboarding.
• Establish recruiting service levels, standardized workflows, clear decision rights, and accountability for recruiters, hiring managers, and business partners.
• Lead the effective use and ongoing optimization of the applicant tracking system, including Greenhouse configuration, workflows, data integrity, reporting, user adoption, and compliance.
• Evaluate recruiting technology and automation opportunities that improve scheduling, candidate engagement, analytics, reporting, and team productivity, and confirm that any automated or AI-assisted screening tools comply with applicable law.
• Partner with Human Resources, IT, Compliance, and Operations to create a coordinated preboarding and onboarding experience, including licensure and credential verification and federal exclusion screening where applicable, that reduces delays and pre-start attrition and accelerates new-hire readiness.
• Use candidate and new-hire feedback to continuously improve the candidate, preboarding, and onboarding experience.

Analytics, KPIs, and Continuous Improvement 
• Develop and maintain a comprehensive talent acquisition measurement framework, including KPIs, dashboards, targets, benchmarks, and reporting standards.
• Track and analyze measures such as hiring-plan attainment, time to fill, time to hire, cost per hire, source effectiveness, pipeline conversion, offer acceptance, candidate withdrawal, recruiter productivity, quality of hire, early retention, and stakeholder satisfaction.
• Conduct regular business reviews with leadership to assess performance, forecast needs, identify risks, and recommend corrective actions or resource changes.
• Ensure data integrity and disciplined system use so recruiting analytics are accurate, timely, consistent, and actionable.
• Develop leading and predictive indicators that allow the organization to anticipate hiring challenges rather than react after vacancies affect operations.

Leadership, Partnership, and Compensation Review 
• Lead, coach, and develop the talent acquisition team, establishing clear expectations, performance standards, operating rhythms, and accountability.
• Serve as a strategic advisor to hiring leaders and provide training, tools, and guidance that improve interview quality, decision-making, and candidate engagement.
• Partner with Human Resources and Finance to evaluate compensation competitiveness using market data, internal equity, candidate feedback, offer outcomes, and hiring performance.
• Recommend adjustments to compensation ranges, geographic differentials, hiring incentives, or offer practices when supported by market and performance data.
• Assess when external search firms, agencies, contract recruiters, or other resources are warranted and manage those relationships and investments effectively.
• Manage recruiting spend within the approved annual budget.

NON-ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES 
• Represent LUX Infusion at recruiting events, professional conferences, educational programs, and community partnerships, as appropriate.
• Support enterprise projects and special workforce initiatives as requested.
• Maintain professional knowledge of recruiting practices, labor-market trends, technology, and applicable employment laws.
• Participate in quality assurance, compliance, and process audits as directed.
• Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Analytics, or equivalent experience in a related field.
• Minimum of 10 years of progressive talent acquisition or human resources experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership or enterprise recruiting role.
• Demonstrated experience developing and executing talent acquisition strategies across multiple states or on a national scale.
• Strong background in workforce planning, recruiting analytics, dashboard development, and the design and implementation of KPIs.
• Proven ability to analyze recruiting data, identify trends and operational risks, and translate findings into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
• Experience building proactive pipelines and sourcing strategies for high-volume, specialized, clinical, professional, and leadership positions.

• Knowledge of federal, state, and local laws and regulations applicable to recruiting and hiring across multiple jurisdictions, including pay transparency, fair-chance and background check, salary history, and automated employment decision tool requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS PREFERRED

• Cross-functional collaboration

Performance Measures

description:
HR & Recruitment Coordinator

Start your career in HR and Talent Acquisition with BioPhorum 

Are you a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career in HR? Are you naturally organised, curious, proactive and someone who enjoys working with people?

We're looking for an enthusiastic Graduate Resourcer & HR Assistant to join our People team at BioPhorum .

This is a great opportunity for someone at the start of their career who wants to gain hands-on experience across recruitment and HR, develop new skills and make a real contribution to a growing international business.

You don't need previous HR or recruitment experience. What matters most to us is your attitude, willingness to learn and desire to get stuck in.

About BioPhorum 

BioPhorum is an international organisation that brings together leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to collaborate, share knowledge and solve some of the industry's biggest challenges.

Our people are at the heart of what we do, and our People team plays an important role in attracting, supporting and developing the talent that helps our business grow.

What will you be doing?

This is a varied role where you'll gain exposure to both recruitment and the wider HR function. You'll work closely with the Talent Partner and wider People team, learning how we attract great people, deliver a positive candidate experience and support employees throughout their time with BioPhorum .

Your responsibilities will include:

Recruitment and Talent Acquisition

- Supporting the recruitment process from initial application through to interview and appointment.

- Reviewing applications and identifying candidates who match our requirements.

- Helping to source and engage potential candidates through different recruitment channels.

- Coordinating interviews, communicating with candidates and keeping everyone updated throughout the process.

- Supporting the preparation of interview materials and recruitment documentation.

- Maintaining accurate candidate information and updating our recruitment systems.

- Helping to ensure candidates have a positive experience when engaging with BioPhorum .

HR and People Support

- Providing general administrative support across the employee lifecycle.

- Supporting onboarding activities for new starters.

- Maintaining accurate employee records and updating our HR system.

- Preparing HR documentation and supporting day-to-day People team activities.

- Helping with wider HR projects and initiatives, including employee engagement and internal communications.

You'll also have the opportunity to get involved in different projects, learn how the People team operates and build your understanding of the wider business.

What we're looking for

We're much more interested in your potential, attitude and approach than how much experience you already have.

You'll ideally be someone who:

- Is a recent graduate, or has equivalent experience, and is keen to build a career in HR or recruitment.

- Is proactive and takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.

- Is naturally organised, able to manage different priorities and has a good eye for detail.

- Has strong communication skills and enjoys interacting with different people.

- Is curious, asks questions and is keen to understand how things work.

- Is confident using technology and comfortable learning new systems.

- Takes responsibility for their work and follows things through.

- Is positive, adaptable and happy to get involved wherever needed.

This isn't just an entry-level administration role. It's an opportunity to build a strong foundation for a career in HR and Talent Acquisition.

You'll gain:

- Hands-on experience across recruitment and the wider employee lifecycle.

- Exposure to different areas of HR and how they support a growing international business.

- The opportunity to work closely with experienced HR and Talent professionals.

- Support, guidance and the chance to develop your skills and confidence.

- Opportunities to contribute to projects and take ownership of your own responsibilities.

- A role where you can make a genuine contribution and see the impact of your work.

Why BioPhorum ?

At BioPhorum , we believe in bringing people together, sharing knowledge and making a difference. You'll be joining a collaborative team where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, take initiative and develop.

If you're looking for a role where you can learn, grow, challenge yourself and build a career in HR, this could be the perfect place to start.

Interested?

We'd love to hear from you. You don't need to have your career all figured out – just bring your enthusiasm, curiosity and willingness to learn.

title: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

About the Role 

As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities 

- Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.

- Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.

- Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.

- Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.

- QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.

- Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.

- Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.

- Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.

- Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.

- Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

Qualifications 

Required 

- At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.

- Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.

- Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.

- Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.

- A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.

- Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.

- Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.

- Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

Preferred 

- Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.

- Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.

- Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).

- Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.

- Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).

- Agency or consulting experience.

Why Current 

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

title: Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

Clover Health is investing in our fraud detection and investigation capabilities and is seeking a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations to join our Legal department as a senior individual contributor. This hybrid role combines: (1) managing hands-on investigations of potential provider fraud with (2) building AI-powered tools and processes to make investigations more efficient and help catch potential future fraud earlier. You will develop and pilot new AI-enabled investigatory processes for Clover’s Medicare Advantage business, and own resulting investigations, in collaboration with Clover’s Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and other stakeholders.

This is a non-attorney role. You will work hand-in-hand with Clover’s lawyers and SIU to ensure that new investigatory processes you develop, and the resulting investigations, comply with Clover policies and regulatory requirements. Success in this role requires someone sharp, creative, and technically hands-on—someone who does not just use existing analytics tools but builds their own. That might mean writing a script to automate repetitive work, pulling apart a dataset when a standard report falls short, or working with an LLM until it produces something genuinely useful—all with the goal of finding smarter, more effective ways to investigate potential provider fraud.

As a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations, you will: 

- Build Your Own Investigative Tooling: Use AI to write the queries, scripts, and prompts that turn millions of claim lines and/or medical record data into a prioritized list of leads. Prototype detection logic yourself rather than waiting on a roadmap, and hand off what works to data science and engineering to productionize. We expect you to be the person who builds v1.

- Investigate Potential Fraud End-to-End With AI in the Loop: Own a portfolio of fraud investigations sourced using the tooling you develop, in collaboration with Clover’s SIU. Develop investigative plans, gather and analyze evidence (including claims data and medical records), and reach well-supported conclusions. Use LLMs and analytics to compress the parts of an investigation that have always been slow — reading unstructured data, triaging grievance narratives, and sizing exposure. 

- Build Defensible Documentation: Develop case files and memos that are factually complete, well-organized, and prepared with the evidentiary and procedural standards necessary for downstream enforcement, recoveries, or provider actions.

- Collaborate Across Functions: Work with Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, provider relations, revenue operations, and SIU teams to gather information, validate findings, and translate investigative outcomes into operational improvements, provider education, and member impact.

- Communicate Findings Clearly: Prepare concise written reports and oral briefings that translate complex investigative facts into clear narratives for senior leadership and other stakeholders.

Success in this role looks like: 

- In your first 90 days , you have embedded yourself as a trusted partner to both the Legal department and Clover’s SIU. You have built working relationships with key stakeholders across Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, revenue operations, and legal teams, and you have begun working through your initial portfolio of fraud investigations and ad hoc referrals.

- By 6 months , you are independently managing a steady caseload of fraud investigations with consistently high-quality work product, in collaboration with SIU. You have a clear working rhythm with Legal and SIU, and you have built at least one working tool — a script, a notebook, a dashboard, a prompt.

- By 12 months , you have a track record of strong investigations, successful recoveries and/or referrals, and effective cross-functional collaboration. Senior leaders across Clover view you as a trusted person to call when they have a hunch that something doesn't look right and want it examined.

You should get in touch if: 

- Knowledge of healthcare fraud schemes & investigative experience: You have experience in healthcare fraud investigations, program integrity, or SIU operations, ideally within Medicare Advantage or managed care. You understand healthcare fraud schemes and know how to use claims data, medical records, and provider documentation to build a defensible factual record.

- You are AI-native and enjoy building things using LLMs: You can use LLMs to write SQL, Python, etc., to interrogate large claims and/or medical record datasets, automate investigative work, and prototype your own solutions rather than waiting for someone else to build them. We do not expect production-grade engineering or require formal technical training—we value demonstrated ability to build, ship, and showcase solutions that work. 

- Strong communication skills: You are a strong writer and communicator who can turn complex investigative findings into clear memos, referrals, and executive summaries, and you are comfortable building in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

Bonus points if: 

- 

- You have built something people actually use—an internal tool, detection model, script, automation, or AI workflow that made a manual process better. We would rather see something scrappy and useful in production than something polished in a slide.

- You have hands-on experience applying AI/ML to fraud, investigations, or compliance.

- You have a J.D., legal training, or experience working alongside Legal, SIU, or compliance at a health plan.

- You have industry certifications such as CFE, AHFI, or CHC.

Benefits Overview :

- Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.

- Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.

- Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. 

- Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks: 

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities

- Reimbursement for office setup expenses

- Monthly cell phone & internet stipend

- Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams

- Paid parental leave for all new parents

- And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Processing
description:
Headquarters: Remote 

Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.

We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. 

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. 

Position: Senior Software Engineer, Processing

Location: Remote

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for our Processing team to lead Lithic’s next phase of growth.

The Processing team builds and maintains the real-time interfaces between Lithic and external payment networks. Every card authorization, clearing message, and settlement file flows through systems this team owns. The team manages both online and batch transaction flows across Mastercard, Visa, and Amex, along with transaction enrichment, disputes processing, and network compliance. The systems we maintain have strict latency and uptime requirements, because they sit on the critical path for every card transaction. The team also manages the physical network peering with card network partners, so infrastructure and networking expertise are important. The team primarily uses Java, Python, and Kotlin on AWS.

What you'll do: 

- Ensure high reliability, low latency, and correctness for Lithic's transaction processing interfaces and related services

- Develop new capabilities across authorization, clearing/settlement, disputes, and network integration surfaces

- Ensure that the team is delivering reliable, secure, and scalable code with minimal tech debt

- Evolve the infrastructure supporting physical network peering with card network partners, ensuring connectivity, failover, and capacity meet reliability requirements

- Own initiatives from planning to launch, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned along the way

- Participate in the team on-call rotation

- Lead efforts to improve systems and processes both within the team and across engineering

- Help drive strategic planning in collaboration with the engineering manager and product manager

What you'll bring: 

- 8+ years experience shipping code in fast paced production environments

- Advanced distributed system instincts and design skills

- Experience driving large cross-functional projects across engineering, product, and operations teams

- A proven commitment to empathy and inclusion

- Excellent communication skills

- Growth mindset and continuous desire to learn and improve is a must

- An interest in fintech and the payments space is preferred

The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. 

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

This is a hybrid position. Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to our NYC office in Soho. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

- Unlimited PTO

NYC-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Connectivity
description:
Headquarters: Portugal - Remote

Be Part of Building the Future 

Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost. Learn more at www.dremio.com. 

About the role 

Dremio's Connectivity team builds the high-performance connectivity solutions that help customers bring data to Dremio and connect Dremio to the broader data ecosystem. The team works across client drivers, protocols, connectors, interoperability, distributed systems, and the reliability and supportability of production data access.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll independently own multiple medium-to-large features or service components within a Connectivity and Clients area. You'll define the approach for a substantial team-area scope, turn ambiguous goals into clear milestones, make sound feature and service-level design decisions, and drive work through reliable production delivery. You will bring deep expertise in at least one area, such as JDBC or ODBC drivers, Apache Arrow ADBC, Arrow Flight SQL, BI interoperability, source connectivity, or connectivity reliability, while contributing effectively across adjacent areas. You will also mentor engineers and influence partner teams through strong technical judgment and execution.

What you'll be doing 

- Own substantial connectivity work: Lead multiple medium-to-large features or service components from problem definition through design, implementation, validation, release readiness, and operational handoff.

- Turn ambiguity into an execution plan: Define reviewable milestones, acceptance measures, dependencies, estimates, and risks for complex customer, product, and engineering goals.

- Design scalable, maintainable systems: Produce technical designs and architecture diagrams, explain trade-offs, and make feature and service-level decisions across drivers, protocols, client libraries, connectors, and distributed services.

- Diagnose complex failures: Lead root-cause analysis across client/server, protocol, network, authentication, metadata, and distributed-system boundaries using logs, telemetry, profiles, benchmarks, and production evidence.

- Build compatibility and reliability: Maintain API and protocol stability; create automated compatibility, interoperability, performance, scale, reliability, observability, and diagnostics coverage; and define practical migration paths for supported and legacy clients.

- Collaborate and influence: Partner with Product, Query Execution, QA, Support, SRE, Documentation, and external technology partners to resolve dependencies and improve certification, customer experience, and supportability.

- Raise the engineering bar: Participate actively in code and design reviews, mentor and coach engineers, improve team practices, and contribute to relevant upstream open-source projects when aligned with Dremio priorities.

- Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly: Apply Dremio-approved AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, and documentation while protecting proprietary and customer data and validating results through review, testing, and sound engineering judgment.

What we're looking for 

- Staff-level ownership: 8+ years of production software engineering experience, or equivalent depth demonstrated through sustained ownership of complex systems and multiple substantial team-area features.

- Programming expertise: Deep proficiency in Java, C++, Rust, Go, or another systems or services language, with the ability to work effectively in adjacent languages and frameworks.

- Connectivity and systems depth: Experience designing and debugging APIs, protocols, client libraries, drivers, or distributed services, with strong knowledge of data structures, concurrency, asynchronous programming, networking, and failure handling.

- Problem-solving ability: Able to identify and solve non-obvious problems across client/server and distributed-system boundaries and turn findings into durable fixes and regression coverage.

- Quality mindset: Experience building comprehensive unit, integration, compatibility, performance, or reliability tests and working with production CI/CD, packaging, release, certification, and engineering quality controls.

- Communication and influence: Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs, surface risks early, align contributors across teams, and influence without formal authority.

- Mentorship: Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach engineers and improve the effectiveness and engineering practices of the team around you.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees and equivalent industry experience are welcomed.

Bonus points if you have 

- Experience developing JDBC, ODBC, ADBC, or other database drivers.

- Experience with Apache Arrow or Arrow Flight SQL.

- Experience with SQL engines, databases, data platforms, or source connectors.

- BI interoperability experience with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools, including collaboration with partner engineering teams.

- Knowledge of OAuth, OIDC, TLS, enterprise authentication, metadata discovery, or query pushdown.

- Cross-platform native build, packaging, release engineering, compatibility certification, or upgrade support experience.

- Observability, production diagnostics, customer escalation, long-running data transfer, cancellation, keepalive, timeout, or proxy experience.

- Contributions to Apache Arrow or other relevant open-source projects.

What we value 

At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife. 

Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor. 

Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 

Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click here to review the privacy notice. 

Important Security Notice for Candidates 

At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement here . 

Dremio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium

URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs 

Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.

Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. 

Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.

Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.

As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.

- You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.

- With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.

- You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.

What are we looking for in you?

- You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.

- Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.

- You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.

- You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.

- You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.

- You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.

- You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.

- You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.

- You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.

- You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.

Twikey offers you:

- An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.

- The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room.

- An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!

- A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.

- A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.

- Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!

- A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.

- A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose.

- The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast!

A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

title: Customer Value Architect III
description:
Headquarters: Remote, US

About Mixpanel 

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .

About the Team 

The Customer Value Architects team sits inside the revenue organization and owns the connection between what customers buy and what they actually get out of Mixpanel. We turn product usage into measurable business outcomes, working across onboarding, adoption, and renewal to make sure customers see the value they signed up for.

About the Role 

The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who connects a customer's Mixpanel investment to real outcomes for a defined book of accounts. You'll own the adoption and value plan for each account end to end: understanding why the customer bought Mixpanel, tracking whether they're getting the ROI they expected, and driving the enablement and product usage that gets them there. You'll build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, partner closely with your Account Executive and renewal counterparts, and bring a growing point of view on how customers should think about AI in their product workflows. This role suits someone who can own a project end to end and is ready to start extending their influence beyond their own accounts to the wider team.

Responsibilities 

- Own the value plan for each account in your portfolio, connecting the business problem that led the customer to buy Mixpanel with the outcomes they measure.

- Build relationships with business and technical stakeholders, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to what customers care about most.

- Run discovery on customer priorities and pain points, and turn what you learn into concrete adoption plans and internal updates.

- Partner with your Account Executive on expansion and your renewal counterpart on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that supports both.

- Lead enablement/best practices sessions on dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling to grow how deeply and widely a customer uses Mixpanel.

- Monitor usage and health signals and lead business reviews that surface what's working, deepen adoption, and catch risk early.

- Spot underused features and contracted capabilities, and turn them into clear recommendations for the customer.

- Triage product questions and issues, solving what you can and routing the rest to the right team.

- Build a working point of view on a customer's AI maturity, and use Mixpanel's own AI surface to help them build on their product data.

- Coordinate with GTM, Product, and Engineering on escalations, and share what works with the broader Customer Value Architects team.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has 

- 4 - 6 years of experience in customer success, consulting, or a related field supporting B2B SaaS accounts, or equivalent experience.

- A track record of managing relationships across a range of stakeholders, from business partners to technical teams.

- The ability to translate technical concepts, like data models and product metrics, into terms that land with non-technical stakeholders.

- Experience turning product usage into a clear story about customer outcomes and ROI.

- Comfort building and running adoption plans that tie daily work to a customer's larger goals.

- Hands-on experience with AI or agentic tooling beyond casual use, such as MCP-based workflows or LLM copilots.

- A collaborative approach to working across account teams and internal partners to move plans forward.

- Good judgment for prioritizing which accounts and actions need attention first.

Bonus Points For 

- Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development.

- Experience in a technical advisory or professional services capacity.

- Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling.

#LI-Remote

Benefits and Perks 

- Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care

- Mental Wellness Benefit

- Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays

- Enhanced Parental Leave

- Volunteer Time Off

- Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary* 

Culture Values 

- Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.

- Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.

- One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.

- Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.

- Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.

- Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel? 

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mixpanel-customer-value-architect-iii-1
